items.title: US crude stocks and distillate inventories fall, gasoline inventories rise, the EIA says
items.author: Liz Hampton, Nicole Jao
items.creator: Liz Hampton, Nicole Jao
items.summary: U.S. crude stocks and distillate inventories fell while gasoline inventories rose last week, the Energy Information Administration said on Wednesday.
items.body:
U.S. crude stocks and distillate inventories fell while gasoline inventories rose last week, the Energy Information Administration said on Wednesday.
Crude inventories fell by 3.2 million barrels to 424.1 million barrels in the week ended October 2, the EIA said, compared with analysts' expectations in a Reuters poll for a 1.7 million-barrel rise.
Crude stocks at the Cushing, Oklahoma, delivery hub (USOICC=ECI) rose by 444,000 barrels in the week, the EIA said.
Refinery crude runs (USOICR=ECI) rose by 223,000 barrels per day in the week, the EIA said, while utilization rates (USOIRU=ECI) rose by 0.2 percentage points to 92.7%.
U.S. gasoline stocks (USOILG=ECI) rose by 0.4 million barrels to 204.7 million barrels, the EIA said, compared with analysts' expectations in a Reuters poll for a 1.7 million-barrel draw.
Distillate stockpiles (USOILD=ECI) , which include diesel and heating oil, were little changed in week at 105.1 million barrels, versus expectations for a 2.1 million-barrel drop, the EIA data showed.
Net U.S. crude imports (USOICI=ECI) fell last week by 53,000 barrels per day, EIA said.

items.title: Webull sinks after CNBC reports US House panel flagged China ties
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Webull's shares fell more than 18% on Wednesday after CNBC reported that a US congressional panel had found the online trading platform "tied in structural ways" to China's government.
items.body:
Webull's (BULL.O) shares fell more than 18% on Wednesday after CNBC reported that a US congressional panel had found the online trading platform "tied in structural ways" to China's government.
The bipartisan House Select Committee on China, in a report set to be released on Wednesday, found "a profound gap" between the company's public marketing and actual control, the report said.
The committee said the company's corporate structure, including "software development, data pipelines, and core engineering operations", was dependent on infrastructure subject directly to Beijing's laws, according to the report.
Stock hit its lowest in nearly four months and was on course for the biggest one-day percentage decline since April last year, if current levels hold.
Webull, the House committee and a spokesperson for the Chinese embassy in the US did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.
"The potential regulatory and operational implications of these findings create a level of uncertainty that we cannot reasonably incorporate into our estimates," Siebert Financial analyst Brian Vieten said, while suspending his buy rating and price target on the stock.
The House committee's findings underscore the growing scrutiny in Washington of Chinese links to companies operating in key areas of the US economy, including financial services.
Last week, Congressman Ro Khanna, a Democrat, warned that [USN:L1N45M17H TEXT:"Beijing could steal"] AI model weights developed by OpenAI, Anthropic and other top US firms, erasing the US edge over China.
US President Donald Trump's lavish three-day summit last month for Chinese President Xi Jinping also [USN:L1N45G0E0 TEXT:"delivered no breakthroughs"] on thorny issues such as AI, trade, Taiwan and the war with Iran.

items.title: Arsenal plot football domination after title win, says CEO Garlick
items.author: Christian Radnedge
items.creator: Christian Radnedge
items.summary: Arsenal are in a strong position to dominate men's football for years to come, CEO Richard Garlick said on Wednesday, minutes after the club announced they had agreed a new long-term deal for manager Mikel Arteta.
items.body:
Arsenal are in a strong position to dominate men's football for years to come, CEO Richard Garlick said on Wednesday, minutes after the club announced they had agreed a new long-term deal for manager Mikel Arteta.
Arteta ended the club's 22-year wait for a Premier League title in May and [USN:L6N45T0OF TEXT:"has extended his contract to 2030"].
The club also reached the Champions League final, losing on penalties to Paris St Germain, and posted club-record revenue. Garlick said, however, they were not resting on their laurels as they seek to build on a stellar campaign on and off the pitch.
"We can't stand still. We can't sit there, pat ourselves on the back, and say job done. This is the beginning, not the end of our journey. This is where we want to go on and show the confidence that that win is going to bring to us," Garlick said at the Leaders Week sports industry conference at Stamford Bridge.
"We want to dominate football for the next number of years. We're in a really strong position to do that, but... we need to keep finding that edge that gives us that advantage, and we have to be brave because it'd be very easy just to simply say 'we'll just roll over what we did last year, and that'll be enough', because everybody's out to get you.
"When you're champions, everybody wants to beat you, and we need to find a way of taking those opportunities and taking those advantages and pushing forward all the time."
Arsenal were ranked seventh in the [USN:L8N3YN0XB TEXT:"2026 Deloitte money league"] for the world's top revenue-generating clubs, behind Manchester City.
However, with City being found guilty of all charges relating to breaches of the Premier League's financial rules from 2009-10 to 2017-18, there may be a gap to exploit in English football. City have appealed the league's decision and continue to deny wrongdoing.
FAITH IN ARTETA Arsenal, owned by American company Kroenke Sports & Entertainment, will be helped by club-record revenue of 822 million euros ($918.91 million) in 2025, a 15% increase from the previous year and more expected this year.
With Arteta's mentor Pep Guardiola having left City in the close season, the Arsenal manager is now the longest-serving manager in the league after joining in December 2019.
Garlick sees that faith in Arteta, who struggled early on in his tenure, as key to Arsenal's growing success.
"I think it gives us a competitive advantage over the other teams because... Mikel is the only manager that's won the Premier League that's currently managing," Garlick said.
"You look at all the other teams in the sort of traditional top six, and they've all gone through managerial changes... whereas we've now got a manager who's been with us for a significant period of time and has been allowed to build and develop a team over a period of time.
"And the excitement now is we see (the) platform that we've got and we build from there."
Arsenal are second in the Premier League standings with 12 points from five games and host Leeds United on Saturday.
($1 = 0.8945 euros)

items.title: Belgian students rally over education costs in protests echoing France
items.author: Bart Biesemans
items.creator: Bart Biesemans
items.summary: Hundreds of students, inspired in part by educational unrest in neighbouring France, have taken to the streets of the Belgian city of Liège, with local media reporting 107 arrests in recent days.
items.body:
Hundreds of students, inspired in part by educational unrest [USN:L1N45T0B2 TEXT:"in neighbouring France"], have taken to the streets of the Belgian city of Liège, with local media reporting 107 arrests in recent days.
Local authorities could not immediately be reached to confirm the arrests, which the Belga news agency reported were linked to offences including property damage and arson.
Students have protested over Belgium's French-language education system, citing rising education costs, overcrowded classrooms and difficulties accessing study materials.
They held signs with slogans including "It's a mess, we are fighting for a right! Not a privilege!" and "I chose education, not the hunger games!!".
The unrest follows June clashes between protesters and police in Brussels over education reforms, including a tuition increase for most students in Belgium's French-speaking Community to €1,194 ($1,280) from €835.
Videos circulating on social media in recent days showed shattered glass, fires and hundreds of mostly young protesters in Liège, while other footage showed police blocking roads.
During Wednesday's protest, police were seen checking students for weapons.
IN TOUCH WITH FRENCH STUDENTS Some students told Reuters they were in touch with French counterparts.
"We support each other because we're facing pretty much the same issues," 19-year-old student Alfred said.
Amelia Di Salve, also 19, who is studying to become a teacher, said Belgium's student movement began earlier this year and was reignited after students saw the demonstrations in France.
"When we saw nothing was changing without protests, we decided we would start ... France did influence us a little," she said.
Liège mayor Willy Demeyer told Belgian broadcaster RTBF he hoped calm would return and "that dialogue can be established and that the young people can express their grievances in a peaceful way and, if possible, have those concerns heard".

items.title: 米政府とグーグル、メタＣＥＯのバイオハブに参画　生物学ＡＩに18億ドル投資へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Krystal Hu

[７日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Krystal Hu

[７日　ロイター] - 米政府と米メタ・プラットフォームズ、グーグル親会社のアルファベットが、非営利研究機関「バイオハブ」に参画し、生物学研究用の人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルの学習に向けたオープンデータセットの構築に乗り出す。この取り組みへの投資総額は１８億ドルに達する見通し。バイオハブが７日に明らかにした。

「バイオハブ」にはメタ、グーグル傘下グーグル・ディープマインド、創薬スタートアップのアイソモルフィックラボが共同で３億ドルを投じる。米エネルギー省は実験室での測定、モデリング、計算に今後５年間で５億ドル超を拠出する。また、米国立衛生研究所（ＮＩＨ）は、５億ドル超の連邦資金でこれまでに構築されたデータセットとリポジトリを調整し、バイオハブがこれらをＡＩの訓練用に標準化する。

バイオハブはメタのマーク・ザッカーバーグ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と妻のプリシラ・チャン氏による慈善事業として運営されている。

モデル訓練向けの生物学データの獲得を巡っては、アンソロピックやオープンＡＩも同様の取り組みを進めている。アンソロピックはＡＩ技術を応用した医薬品開発の本格化に向け、生物学の研究を行うための実験施設（ウェットラボ）を開設した。オープンＡＩ財団はＡＩ研究向けの生物・医療データセット構築のため、１億２５００万ドル超の助成プログラムを開始した。

items.title: Kenya central bank keeps main lending rate unchanged
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kenya's central bank maintained its benchmark lending rate at 8.75%, it said on Wednesday after a meeting of its Monetary Policy Committee.
items.body:
Kenya's central bank maintained its benchmark lending rate (KECBIR=ECI) at 8.75%, it said on Wednesday after a meeting of its Monetary Policy Committee.
It was the fourth policy meeting in a row that the Central Bank of Kenya has kept the rate unchanged.
A Reuters poll of 11 economists had nine predicting a hold, while two had predicted a raise to 9.0%.
Kenya's inflation (KECPI=ECI) rose to 6.8% year-on-year in September from 6.6% a month earlier, moving closer to the upper end of the government's preferred 2.5%-7.5% range.
Inflation is expected to remain within the target range in the near term, the bank said in a statement.

items.title: Fondo Milagro: el Gobierno pagará COP$248 millones al mes a Fiducoldex para administrar la reconstrucción
items.author: María C. Suárez
items.summary: La fiduciaria pública fue elegida por contratación directa para manejar el patrimonio autónomo con el que se financiará la recuperación tras el terremoto del 10 de agosto.
items.body: Bogotá — El Gobierno Nacional ya tiene administrador para los recursos de la reconstrucción. El Ministerio de Hacienda escogió a Fiducoldex para constituir y administrar el patrimonio autónomo del Fondo Milagro, creado para atender la asistencia, recuperación y reconstrucción tras el terremoto del pasado 10 de agosto en Colombia. Por esa labor, la fiduciaria recibirá una comisión que rondaría los COP$248 millones mensuales. El contrato fija una comisión mensual fija de 142 salarios mínimos legales vigentes, que se causa desde el inicio de la ejecución y hasta su terminación. Con el salario mínimo de 2026, que se mantiene en COP$1.750.905 mensuales, el pago equivale a unos COP$248,6 millones al mes, es decir, cerca de COP$2.983 millones al año. Frente al capital inicial del fondo, esa remuneración representa aproximadamente el 0,3% anual. Ver más: Inflación de Colombia en septiembre: mercado prevé que siga por encima del 6,2% La cartera de Hacienda argumentó que la emergencia permitía acudir a esta modalidad sin abrir un proceso competitivo entre fiduciarias públicas. Entre los criterios evaluados figuraron la liquidez, el endeudamiento, la eficiencia en la ejecución de recursos y la calificación vigente en administración de inversiones. La Fiduprevisora también fue evaluada, pero quedó por fuera por su carga operativa: ya administra numerosos negocios fiduciarios públicos de gran volumen, entre ellos el Fondo Nacional de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres, que también participa en la atención de la emergencia. Fiducoldex, por su parte, es una sociedad de economía mixta vinculada al Ministerio de Comercio, filial de Bancoldex y vigilada por la Superintendencia Financiera. El fondo fue creado mediante el Decreto 1379 como patrimonio autónomo para financiar asistencia humanitaria, recuperación, rehabilitación, reconstrucción, reactivación económica y reducción del riesgo en los territorios afectados por el sismo. El terremoto, de magnitud 7,4, golpeó ciudades, municipios y comunidades, y el Fondo Milagro arrancará con COP$1billón que empezarán a asignarse desde ya. Desde Pereira, el presidente Abelardo De la Espriella celebró que ya quedó listo el Fondo Milagro. Parte de la financiación vendrá de deuda: mediante el Decreto 1488 del 6 de octubre, el Gobierno agregó COP$624.656 millones al Presupuesto General de la Nación, recursos obtenidos con crédito externo y destinados al fondo. Los recursos podrán financiar infraestructura de salud, educación, transporte, agua potable, saneamiento básico, energía, telecomunicaciones y vivienda, además de proyectos de reactivación económica. Un consejo directivo aprobará proyectos, presupuestos y criterios de priorización. Ver más: Estos son los países más ricos de Latinoamérica en activos financieros por habitante, según Allianz Jaime Andrés Uribe Tamayo fue designado gerente, con la tarea de coordinar la reconstrucción, articular recursos públicos y privados y supervisar las obras. En cuanto al control, el decreto dispone que la Contraloría General vigilará el manejo del fondo y de las subcuentas con recursos públicos. Su duración será la necesaria para concluir los proyectos, con una evaluación al menos anual sobre si debe seguir existiendo.

items.title: Attacks on tankers in Hormuz hit highest of any week since start of Iran war, sources say
items.author: Jonathan Saul
items.creator: Jonathan Saul
items.summary: Attacks on tankers sailing through the Strait of Hormuz hit their highest last week of any week since the Iran war began, according to maritime security sources tracking incidents, amid a bigger export push by Gulf producers.
items.body:
Attacks on tankers sailing through the Strait of Hormuz hit their highest last week of any week since the Iran war began, according to maritime security sources tracking incidents, amid a bigger export push by Gulf producers.
Attacks, attempted attacks and harassment activity including drone overflights, surveillance and hailing using VHF radio by Iran's Revolutionary Guards have persisted in the strait, the US Navy-led Joint Maritime Information Center (JMIC) said in a note on Sunday.
"These actions continue to demonstrate Iran’s intent to assert presence along key transit lanes and maintain pressure on transiting vessels," the JMIC said.
In the week of September 28-October 5, there had been at least 12 attacks on oil, liquefied natural gas and liquefied petroleum gas tankers around the Strait of Hormuz, according to data from three maritime security sources who analysed incidents based on information received from the area.
That was the highest number of attacks in a single week since the US war with Iran began on February 28, the sources said.
Separate data collated by the UN's shipping agency, the International Maritime Organization (IMO), showed nine incidents involving vessels in the same week.
The UN body tends to take longer to verify and officially record incidents, maritime sources say.
The closest week in terms of comparable incidents was the week of July 13 when there were eight incidents, separate IMO data showed.
Gulf oil exporters topped [USN:L1N45R04U TEXT:"pre-war levels for about half of September"], shipping data showed on Monday, though attacks on tankers and logistical constraints cloud the outlook for sustained higher flows.
India's foreign ministry said on Tuesday that 12 crew members [USN:L4N45S0VH TEXT:"were injured"] after an unknown projectile struck Panama-flagged oil tanker On Peace while it was passing through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Bolsa mexicana cae luego de tres sesiones de alzas, espera minutas Fed
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La bolsa mexicana caía el miércoles y cortaba una racha de tres alzas consecutivas ante un menor apetito por el riesgo debido al alza del petróleo y a la espera de la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos.
items.body:
La bolsa mexicana caía el miércoles y cortaba una racha de tres alzas consecutivas ante un menor apetito por el riesgo debido al alza del petróleo y a la espera de la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos.
El índice líder S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que agrupa a las acciones más negociadas del mercado local, perdía un 0.68% a 64,867.87 puntos, en línea con la fuerte baja de Wall Street después de que el S&P 500 y el Nasdaq cerraran en la víspera en máximos récord.
Los títulos del Grupo Aeroportuario GAP (GAPB.MX) lideraban los descensos del mercado bursátil local con una pérdida de 2.68% a 367,98 pesos. Les seguían las acciones de la cementera Cemex , que perdían un 2.23% a 17.56 pesos.
Los precios del crudo subían el miércoles y los futuros del Brent se mantenían por sobre los 100 dólares el barril, lo que mantenía las preocupaciones sobre las presiones inflacionarias. Más tarde, la Fed divulgará las minutas de su último encuentro, en el que subió las tasas de interés al rango del 3.75%-4% y señaló que podrían producirse nuevas alzas.

items.summary: Hezbollah has received $200 million from Iran to help Lebanese displaced by this year’s war with Israel, two people with direct knowledge of the transfer said, the first significant aid from the group to supporters who bore the brunt of the conflict.
items.body:
Hezbollah has received $200 million from Iran to help Lebanese displaced by this year’s war with Israel, two people with direct knowledge of the transfer said, the first significant aid from the group to supporters who bore the brunt of the conflict.
[USN:L1N42A08R TEXT:"Hezbollah"] received the cash last month despite a tightening US economic [USN:L8N44N1OO TEXT:"chokehold"] on Iran and increasing difficulties in getting funds to Tehran's Lebanese ally, said the people.
Intermediaries who moved the money charged a 20% fee, reflecting the risks of dealing with the group, they said. One said this was four times the normal fee.
Asked for comment, a Hezbollah official said an amount had been secured and a plan for distributing it would be announced in the coming days, without elaborating on the source of the funds.
The Iranian foreign ministry, Iran's permanent mission in Geneva, the US State Department and the Lebanese government did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Israel’s bombardment and invasion of Lebanon [USN:L8N4241VG TEXT:"uprooted "]hundreds of thousands of Hezbollah’s Shi’ite Muslim constituents after the group entered the regional war in support of Iran on March 2.
But those displaced have so far received little to no assistance from Hezbollah, an armed group founded by Iran’s Revolutionary Guards in 1982 which has suffered heavy Israeli blows in two wars since 2024 and is designated a terrorist group by Washington.
AIDING 50,000 FAMILIES Hezbollah would use the funds to pay an initial $3,000 per family, and priority will go to those whose villages have been destroyed or are inaccessible due to Israeli occupation, the sources said. These number around 50,000 families, one of the sources said.
Iran has maintained financial support to Hezbollah through years of crippling US sanctions: it transferred $1 billion to the group in the first 10 months of 2025, according to the US Treasury Department.
Tehran has never acknowledged financing Hezbollah. Iran's policy of funding regional proxies has stirred domestic protester anger against the clerical rulers in the past and could prove particularly sensitive at a time of [USN:L6N45K0UX TEXT:"worsening hardship in Iran"].
Iran had [USN:L8N42P09O TEXT:"promised Hezbollah"] more funding after Tehran signed an interim deal with Washington in June that allowed Iran to sell its oil, Reuters reported at the time. That agreement collapsed in July.
Washington has since intensified economic pressure on Iran, tightening sanctions and imposing a naval blockade to block Iranian oil exports.
Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem said in a speech last month that the group would soon contribute to a project aimed at housing thousands of people displaced by the war, using “available resources and donations”, without elaborating.
Hezbollah's ability to fund local services and provide post-conflict aid has helped shore up its support in the past. Following a war with Israel in 2006, the group immediately handed out large cash payments to those impacted and moved swiftly to help rebuild Beirut's southern suburbs, a stronghold.
But this time there has been little sign of reconstruction. Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam said last month that the total reconstruction costs from the two wars since 2024 could exceed $27 billion.
A COSTLY WAR The two sources provided no details on how the money got to Lebanon.
One of them said it was increasingly difficult for Hezbollah to move funds via financial companies that once processed such transfers. Such firms based in Iraq and Dubai were no longer an option, and they were also now under pressure in Turkey, this source said.
Hezbollah’s foes believed money was currently the group’s “oxygen”, the source added. Despite the difficulties securing funding, the group had not stopped paying its fighters and the family members of those killed in combat, this source said.
In Lebanon, the war has inflicted a heavy price on the Shi’ite Muslim community from which Hezbollah draws support. Israel has razed villages across a swathe of territory it has seized in the south, saying it aims to shield northern Israel from Hezbollah attack.
Israeli attacks in Lebanon have killed more than 4,300 people since March 2, according to Lebanon’s health ministry. Its toll does not say how many combatants may be among the dead. Hezbollah has not disclosed figures on its war dead. Reuters reported on May 4 that several thousand Hezbollah fighters had been killed in the war.

items.title: Na Semana de Moda de Paris verões mais longos e quentes representam novo desafio
items.author: Helen Reid
items.creator: Helen Reid
items.summary: Verões mais longos e quentes estão perturbando o calendário sazonal da moda, forçando as marcas de luxo a adaptar seus designs e ameaçando as vendas de roupas de inverno, que geram margens de lucro mais altas.
items.body:
Verões mais longos e quentes estão perturbando o calendário sazonal da moda, forçando as marcas de luxo a adaptar seus designs e ameaçando as vendas de roupas de inverno, que geram margens de lucro mais altas.
O ciclo tradicional do setor há muito depende da compra de roupas de outono e inverno pelos consumidores à medida que as temperaturas caem. Mas os outonos mais quentes estão adiando a demanda por casacos e outras peças para o frio, deixando os varejistas expostos ao risco de excesso de estoque e descontos.
Em Paris, os outdoors da Saint Laurent durante a Semana da Moda mostravam uma modelo envolta em um casaco de pele grosso, enquanto o Sol brilhava e os turistas passeavam pelas ruas vestindo camisetas e shorts.
“Todo o setor deve perceber que, com as mudanças climáticas e as temperaturas mais altas, a época de vender casacos mudou para mais tarde”, disse Pau Almar, consultor do setor de varejo que trabalhou por uma década na Zara.
Essa desconexão ficou evidente durante a Semana da Moda de Paris, onde as temperaturas chegaram a 28 graus Celsius e muitos convidados optaram por blusas sem mangas e minissaias em vez das coleções de outono recém-lançadas.
Normalmente, os convidados dos desfiles de primavera/verão, realizados no final de setembro, aparecem vestidos com peças de outono/inverno recém-lançadas nas lojas. No desfile da Louis Vuitton na terça-feira, porém, os casacos eram raros.
“Não acredito que já é outubro aqui em Paris e eu estava pensando que deveria ter trazido algumas das minhas roupas de verão de Miami”, disse Suzy Buckley Woodward, uma convidada do desfile.
ADAPTAÇÃO DE DESIGNS, RISCOS NO VAREJO O estilista da linha feminina da Louis Vuitton, Nicolas Ghesquière, já está adaptando seus designs, afirmando que as ondas de calor recordes na Europa tiveram uma “forte influência” em sua última coleção, que apresentou tecidos finos e cortes arejados.
“O foco foi em como criar roupas que fossem quase como trajes de banho, como uma segunda pele”, disse ele aos repórteres após o desfile de terça-feira.
O clima quente da semana passada fez com que alguns convidados, vestidos com roupas de outono, ficassem com calor excessivo no desfile de primavera/verão da Dior nos Jardins das Tulherias, apesar dos ventiladores de teto instalados acima da passarela.
As altas temperaturas persistentes também representam um desafio para as redes de varejo de moda de massa, à medida que as lojas começam a substituir camisetas por jaquetas e malhas, enfrentando o risco de ter que dar descontos no estoque excedente.
As lojas terão que se adaptar para vender menos casacos pesados e mais peças de transição, disse Almar.
Os lucros podem ficar sob pressão, já que os agasalhos costumam ter margens de lucro mais altas, e um inverno atrasado aumenta o risco de mais consumidores esperarem até os descontos da Black Friday, no final de novembro, para comprar um casaco novo.

items.title: How AI is Changing the Fan Experience, with Jump’s Jordy Leiser
items.summary: There are a lot of concerns surrounding artificial intelligence’s creep into all aspects of day-to-day life, but Jordy Leiser also sees a lot of opportunity for AI to help sports fans. On this week’s episode of The Deal, Jordy tells Alex and Jason Kelly how AI can help fans interact with their favorite teams and players, and how a new wave of team owners who made their money in tech are helping to power innovation in the sports industry. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Peso mexicano cae a la espera de minutas de Reserva Federal EEUU
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El peso mexicano descendía el miércoles tras dos jornadas de alzas y cotizaba por sobre la barrera de las 18 unidades por dólar ante el avance del billete verde en los mercados globales, mientras esperan la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal.
items.body:
El peso mexicano descendía el miércoles tras dos jornadas de alzas y cotizaba por sobre la barrera de las 18 unidades por dólar ante el avance del billete verde en los mercados globales, mientras esperan la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal.
La moneda local cotizaba en 18.0580 unidades por dólar, con una pérdida del 0.46% frente al precio de referencia de LSEG del martes, y luego de dos días de alzas. La semana pasada llegó a negociarse en 18.4330, su nivel más débil desde noviembre de 2025.
"Hoy, el peso mexicano se debilita ante un dólar firme, en línea con la mayoría de las divisas de economías emergentes, ya que regresaron las condiciones de aversión global al riesgo y las preocupaciones inflacionarias. Los niveles de soporte y resistencia se ubican en $17.98 y $18.18 respectivamente, en el mercado interbancario", dijo la correduría Monex en un reporte.
El dólar subía frente a las principales divisas en la jornada impulsado por el alza de los precios del petróleo, mientras los inversores esperan las minutas de la última reunión de la Fed en que el banco central subió la tasa de interés en 25 puntos básicos al rango del 3.75%-4%, y señaló que podrían producirse nuevas alzas para contener la inflación.

items.title: Pfizer to cut around 330 jobs in Italy
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Pfizer will cut around 330 jobs in Italy at its Sicily plant, labour unions said on Wednesday, making the US drugmaker the latest international company downsizing its Italian operations.
items.body:
Pfizer (PFE.N) will cut around 330 jobs in Italy at its Sicily plant, labour unions said on Wednesday, making the US drugmaker the latest international company downsizing its Italian operations.
Talks in Rome between Pfizer and Italy's industry ministry late on Tuesday did not yield results, the CGIL, CISL and UIL unions said in a statement.
Pfizer's Sicily plant currently has 550 employees, unions said.
Pfizer was not immediately available for comment.
Italy's industry ministry said "the points raised during the meeting serve as a starting point for strengthening the dialogue," adding that industry minister Adolfo Urso would visit the plant on October 23.
Further talks between Pfizer and the ministry are scheduled for November 10, the ministry added.
Earlier this week, appliance maker Electrolux (ELUXb.ST) [USN:L1N45R0PJ TEXT:"presented"] a scaled-down restructuring plan for its Italian operations, with around 1,250 jobs now expected to be made redundant.
Swedish telecoms equipment maker Ericsson (ERICb.ST) also said on Monday that, following talks with the ministry, a collective layoff of 131 workers in Genoa would be dropped in favour of a voluntary restructuring plan.

items.title: Eritrean troops drive through northern Ethiopian town, witnesses say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Eritrean soldiers drove through the northern Ethiopian town of Adigrat on Wednesday, two witnesses told Reuters, days after the Horn of Africa neighbours severed diplomatic ties, raising fears of outright conflict.
items.body:
Eritrean soldiers drove through the northern Ethiopian town of Adigrat on Wednesday, two witnesses told Reuters, days after the Horn of Africa neighbours [USN:L6N45N0FL TEXT:"severed diplomatic ties"], raising [USN:L6N45M0WY TEXT:"fears of outright conflict"].
The sightings of Eritrean troops would be the first confirmation of their presence on Ethiopian soil during the conflict in the country's north between the federal government and a rebel alliance that broke out last month.
Eritrea’s information minister Yemane Gebremeskel denied Eritrean forces were there, calling the witness accounts part of an Ethiopian plan to justify a war of aggression against its smaller neighbour.
Ethiopia has accused Eritrea of backing the rebel alliance battling federal government troops since September 23 in the northern regions of Tigray, Amhara and Afar. Afar's chief administrator said last week that Eritrean troops were fighting in his region, but Reuters could not confirm that.
Asmara has denied the allegations, which led to the severing of diplomatic ties last week.
Spokespeople for Ethiopia's government and Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
WITNESSES SAW ERITREAN TROOPS DRIVING THROUGH TOWN Two residents of Adigrat, a town in Tigray about 25 km (15 miles) south of the Eritrean border that has not experienced clashes during the current conflict, said they had seen two trucks with dozens of Eritrean soldiers driving through the town on Wednesday morning.
They said they could identify the soldiers as Eritrean by their off-white camouflage uniforms.
Another Adigrat resident who was not in town at the time said family members had told him they had also seen Eritrean troops.
Reuters could not independently verify their accounts. All spoke on condition of anonymity because of security concerns related to the ongoing conflict.
The Eritrean information minister Yemane said the allegations were intended to provide Ethiopia with a pretext to attack Eritrea.
For over three years, Abiy and other Ethiopian officials have repeatedly said that sea access is vital for their landlocked country's security and economy. Asmara views those comments as an implicit threat against it, while Addis Ababa has said it aims to gain sea access peacefully.
Ethiopia “has tried to re-package this war agenda in terms of self-defence by fabricating various allegations against Eritrea,” Yemane said. “So we connect the dots.”
NORTHERN ETHIOPIA CONFLICT FUELS FEARS OF WIDER WAR Eritrean soldiers fought in support of Ethiopia’s federal government during a 2020-2022 civil war in Tigray.
Some of them remained in northern parts of Tigray close to the border well after the war ended, according to Ethiopia’s government, UN experts and human rights organisations. Eritrea denied this.
The fighting that broke out last month has raised fear that unrest could spread beyond Ethiopia’s borders in an increasingly fragile region where other powers are competing for influence.
Tigray has Ethiopia's longtime foe Eritrea to its north, and Sudan — caught up in a more than three-year-old civil war — to its west.
Ethiopia's government has also accused Egypt and Sudan of supporting the opposition alliance. Both have denied this.
On Saturday, the US State Department urged Asmara and Addis Ababa to exercise restraint, warning that a conflict would jeopardise US collaboration with both countries.
Eritrea, a former province of Ethiopia, won its statehood in 1993 after a 30-year independence struggle. The two countries fought a border war from 1998-2000 that killed tens of thousands.
They normalised diplomatic relations in 2018, winning Abiy the Nobel Peace Prize, but relations soured once again during the 2020-2022 Tigray war.

items.title: イラン高官、米の核開発巡る「考え」相いれず　核濃縮はレッドライン
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ドバイ ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ドバイ ７日 ロイター] - イラン当局者は７日、同国の核開発計画に関する米国の「要求や構想」はイラン側の要求と相いれないとの認識を示した。

バンス米副大統領が、イランは米国の要求を満たし７カ月に及ぶ戦争を終結させるためには、ウラン濃縮能力を「意味のある形で」削減する必要があるとの考えを示したことについて、当局者はロイターに対し、「バンス氏の発言は米政権の考えや要求を反映したものだ。米国側には要求を示し、自らの考えを持つ自由があるが、その内容はイランの要求とは相いれない」と語った。

さらに、イランの核開発計画を巡り、米国との交渉は一切行われておらず、核協議を開始するには米国がイラン側の条件を満たす必要があると述べた。また、核濃縮に関する条件はイランにとっての「レッドライン（越えられない一線）」であり、「この点についてはいかなる形でも柔軟性を示すことはない」とした。ただ、濃縮の詳細を巡り後日協議することは可能との認識も示した。

items.title: Russia plague scare: 200 quarantined, 5,000 tests, no confirmed cases, no epidemic risk; — latest updates
items.author: Ravi Hari
items.summary: Here are the latest updates following the initial plague scare in Siberia: Russia has ruled out an epidemic risk, while the WHO continues to seek more information about the laboratory worker’s unexplained death.
items.body: Russia’s health regulator has said there is no risk of an epidemic in Siberia after a 28-year-old worker at a plague research institute died of pneumonia of unknown origin, even as the World Health Organization (WHO) continues to seek more information from Moscow.The death of Darya Shipilova, a laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute, triggered international concern after reports suggested she may have contracted pneumonic plague following an alleged laboratory incident. Russian authorities have rejected those reports and said no plague has been detected.Here are the latest updates following the initial plague scare in Siberia: Russia has ruled out an epidemic risk, while the WHO continues to seek more information about the laboratory worker’s unexplained death.Russia winds down precautionary measuresRospotrebnadzor, Russia’s health watchdog, said it was winding down precautionary measures introduced after Shipilova’s death, after determining there was no epidemic threat to the population.Around 200 people were initially placed under quarantine or medical observation. The regulator said about 90% had since been released and that nearly 5,000 laboratory tests had found no dangerous pathogens.No plague infection has been identified among people who had contact with Shipilova, according to Russian authorities.Rospotrebnadzor also said Shipilova had been vaccinated and was considered immune to the dangerous infections handled at the institute. However, authorities have not established what caused the pneumonia that led to her death.WHO seeks clarity on cause of pneumoniaWHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the UN health agency had requested additional information from Russia to clarify the circumstances surrounding the case.The WHO is seeking details on the cause of the severe pneumonia, the pathogen that prompted Russia to introduce public-health measures and reports of a second employee with pneumonia of undetermined cause.The agency said Russia had reported that no case of plague had recently been registered in the Irkutsk region.The WHO has also mobilised experts to assess the situation. Based on the information available, it has assessed the risk as moderate to low in Irkutsk, low for Russia overall and very low for the WHO European region.Kremlin rejects reports of second plague caseThe Kremlin has dismissed reports circulating about a possible second suspected plague case in Siberia.Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said a large amount of media coverage had emerged around the incident but that most of it was false information. He urged the public and media to rely on information provided by Russian health authorities.Reuters said it was unable to find evidence in Russian media that a second person in Siberia had died of plague, although some social media bloggers had made unsupported claims.Russia says no laboratory accident occurredRussian authorities have said their investigation found no laboratory accident involving dangerous microorganisms.Testing of samples from Shipilova also reportedly found no microorganisms associated with the pathogens she worked with. Authorities have maintained that the epidemiological situation in the Irkutsk region is stable and that the official cause of her illness remains pneumonia of unknown origin.Earlier reports from Russian outlet People of Baikal had alleged that Shipilova died of plague, potentially after exposure from a broken test tube. Russian officials have disputed those reports.US and EU seek transparencyThe case has drawn scrutiny beyond Russia. The United States formally requested additional information from Moscow through a confidential diplomatic communication, according to a source familiar with the matter.US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has called for greater transparency, while President Donald Trump said he expected to speak with Russian President Vladimir Putin about the incident.The European Union has also urged Russia to provide timely and transparent reporting and said reliable epidemiological and microbiological findings were needed.Mongolia increases border health surveillanceMongolia has introduced additional health surveillance along its border with Russia, although its government said the current risk level remained low.Border crossings in Selenge province continue to operate normally, with health monitoring measures in place.China has also said it remains in close communication with Russia on infectious-disease prevention and control, including plague.What remains unknownThe key unresolved issue remains what caused Shipilova’s pneumonia and death.Pneumonia can result from a range of bacterial and viral infections and can also occur with pneumonic plague. Pneumonic plague affects the lungs and can spread between people through respiratory particles, but there is currently no confirmed evidence that Shipilova had plague or that the disease has spread among her contacts.For now, Russian authorities say there is no epidemic threat, while the WHO continues to seek additional information to resolve conflicting reports and assess the potential public-health risk.(With inputs from AFP, AP, Reuters, Bloomberg)

items.title: Westons to buy U.K. pharmacy chain Boots for US$8.9B
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The family behind Canada’s biggest pharmacy and grocery chains is growing its empire with the acquisition of U.K. drugstore Boots.
items.body: TORONTO — The family behind Canada’s biggest pharmacy and grocery chains is growing its empire with the acquisition of U.K. drugstore Boots. Weston family holding company Wittington Investments said Wednesday that it will purchase Boots for US$8.9 billion (almost $12.7 billion), including debt, from private equity firm Sycamore Partners. Along with Boots’ retail operations in the U.K. and Ireland, Wittington will acquire its operations in Thailand and franchised businesses, its optical division and No7 Beauty Company. Toronto-based holding company Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd. will partner with Wittington on the acquisition and after its closing, expected in the first quarter of 2027, Galen Weston will become Boots’ chairman. Boots is among Britain’s most prominent retailers and has many similarities to Shoppers Drug Mart, the Canadian pharmacy giant with ties to the Westons. The Westons are best known in Canada for building Loblaw Cos. Ltd. and George Weston Ltd. and owning luxury department store Holt Renfrew. They also have a stake in Associated British Foods, the parent company of value retailer Primark and the makers of Twinings tea, Mazola oils, Mazzetti vinegars, Ovaltine and Fleischmann’s yeast. It’s unclear whether the acquisition will bring Boots, which was founded in 1849 and operated for a time in Canada, back to the country. If Boots made a Canadian return, it could become a competitor with Shoppers, which counts about 1,350 stores in Canada. Boots has roughly 1,800 locations. When a Boots acquisition by the Westons was rumoured in late September, RBC Capital Markets analyst Irene Nattel thought the deal made some sense. “We believe there is substantial organizational knowledge and understanding of retail pharmacy within the Weston family of businesses and investments, knowledge that would prove extremely useful should a transaction come to fruition,” she wrote in a Sept. 30 note to investors. She didn’t see a potential deal as having much impact on Loblaw nor George Weston, if it was completed through the family’s private investment arm Wittington. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 7, 2026. Tara Deschamps, The Canadian Press

Oct 7 : After suffering a major legislative defeat at the hands of Senate Democrats last month, the crypto industry is grappling with a dilemma three weeks out from the November election: punish Democrats, or preserve the bipartisan ties it has spent years building.
During the current and previous election cycles, the industry has spent more than $300 million backing crypto-friendly Democrats and Republicans in roughly equal measure, hoping to pass legislation US crypto companies say will put them on a solid legal footing and allow them to thrive.
That strategy paid off with last year's new law promoting dollar-backed cryptocurrencies, but suffered a major blow last month when all Senate Democrats and a handful of Republicans voted against advancing the Clarity Act, which the industry says would have provided the legal clarity it has long lobbied for.
US President Donald Trump's personal crypto ventures became a flashpoint in the bill negotiations, prompting Democrats to push for tougher restrictions on officeholders' crypto dealings. Their decision to vote against the bill despite winning many concessions angered crypto executives, while the broader fight has made crypto more of a partisan issue, said analysts.

Nine Democrats are up for reelection in the Senate, including some the industry had viewed as allies. With polls showing the party has a slight edge, the crypto industry is weighing whether to continue with its bipartisan strategy in the Senate, or to reward Republicans, who overwhelmingly supported Clarity, said four executives involved in the discussions.
While it's unlikely a Democratic-led Senate will pass crypto legislation, turning the midterms into a referendum on Clarity could squander years of relationship-building and alienate lawmakers who may be in power next year, some executives warn.
“It's a pretty hard needle to thread," said Ron Hammond, head of policy and advocacy at crypto trading firm Wintermute, adding that the big crypto spenders have been "navigating this very carefully."
CRYPTO HAS PUNISHED ADVERSARIES BEFORE
Fairshake, a crypto super PAC backed by Coinbase and Ripple among others, started the year with $193 million. On Monday, it said it would back 32 House candidates spanning both parties, but has not announced a Senate strategy. It has spent on 57 races this cycle, winning many.
“Fairshake has always been and always will be an issue-focused organization. We back pro-crypto candidates who support American innovation in both parties," said spokesperson Geoff Vetter.
Crypto PACs have previously targeted vulnerable adversaries. In 2024, Fairshake spent about $40 million successfully unseating former incumbent Ohio Senate Democrat Sherrod Brown, who criticized the industry's Washington influence. In a sign of what may come, the PAC is spending $30 million opposing his bid to return to the Senate.
Digital Freedom Fund, a super PAC backed by crypto entrepreneurs Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, is also spending $3 million opposing Brown and supporting current Ohio Republican Senator Jon Husted, who voted for Clarity, federal filings show.
It's also spending $400,000 in the race for Iowa's open Senate seat, splitting the cash between backing pro-crypto Republican Ashley Hinson and opposing her Democratic rival.
Spokespeople for the Winklevoss twins and Hinson did not respond to requests for comment. Ripple declined to comment.
A spokesperson for Brown's campaign accused Husted of being "for sale." A Husted campaign spokesperson said Brown was "terrified of having his abysmal record splashed across TV screens."
Until recently, the industry's aggressive spending made candidates think twice about crossing it, analysts say, but executives worry it's a risky strategy, especially against incumbents. Many believe crypto can still be a bipartisan issue and that the industry should find ways to settle scores without jeopardizing those ties.
Among those up for reelection, for example, are New Jersey's Cory Booker and Virginia's Mark Warner, both senior Democratic lawmakers whom the industry sees as key allies. They broadly supported crypto legislation but ultimately opposed Clarity, citing insufficient curbs on officeholder crypto dealings.
Warner and Booker sit on the Senate Banking and Agriculture committees respectively, which jointly drafted the bill. With both senators in relatively safe races, attacking them could backfire, executives said. Spokespeople for the senators' campaigns did not respond to requests for comment.
Senate control would also hand Democrats committee oversight powers which they plan to use to probe crypto companies with ties to Trump. In what analysts said was a potentially ironic twist, there is a chance that Brown, whom recent polls put slightly ahead of Husted, could reprise his leadership of the Banking Committee if he wins.
One of the crypto executives who wished to remain anonymous said attacking Democrats "didn't do us a lot of good," and others expect the industry will ultimately focus on rewarding friends in either party.
"I do think you're going to see the industry lick its wounds and get back aggressively to supporting the pro-Clarity type folks," said Josh Riezman, chief legal and strategy officer at crypto firm GSR.
Stand With Crypto, a nonprofit backed by Coinbase, has endorsed dozens of candidates and is spending on advertising in some races. Its executive director Mason Lynaugh last month warned that the Clarity vote had exposed which officials were "against" the industry.
But most of its latest endorsements are for House or Senate lawmakers who voted for Clarity on both sides of the aisle.
“We have the potential to move the outcomes or at least play a significant factor in helping reelect these crypto champions," said Lynaugh.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Gobierno EEUU y Google se unen a Biohub, que busca recopilar datos sobre biología aplicada a la IA
items.author: Krystal Hu
items.creator: Krystal Hu
items.summary: El Gobierno de Estados Unidos y los gigantes tecnológicos Meta Platforms y Alphabet , matriz de Google, se unen a la organización sin ánimo de lucro Biohub para crear conjuntos de datos abiertos con los que entrenar modelos de IA destinados a la investigación biológica, lo que eleva la inversión total en esta iniciativa a 1.800 millones de dólares, dijo Biohub el miércoles.
items.body:
El Gobierno de Estados Unidos y los gigantes tecnológicos Meta Platforms y Alphabet , matriz de Google, se unen a la organización sin ánimo de lucro Biohub para crear conjuntos de datos abiertos con los que entrenar modelos de IA destinados a la investigación biológica, lo que eleva la inversión total en esta iniciativa a 1.800 millones de dólares, dijo Biohub el miércoles.
Meta (META.O) , Google DeepMind y la startup dedicada al descubrimiento de fármacos Isomorphic Labs invertirán conjuntamente 300 millones de dólares. El Departamento de Energía invertirá más de 500 millones de dólares a lo largo de cinco años en mediciones de laboratorio, modelización y cálculo.
Los Institutos Nacionales de Salud coordinarán los conjuntos de datos y los repositorios creados con más de 500 millones de dólares de financiación federal anterior, que Biohub estandarizará para el entrenamiento de la IA.
Estos compromisos se suman a los 500 millones de dólares que Biohub —una iniciativa filantrópica del director ejecutivo de Meta, Mark Zuckerberg, y su esposa, la doctora Priscilla Chan— destinó al proyecto en abril.
Las inversiones financian la Iniciativa de Biología Virtual, cuyo objetivo es medir cómo responden las células a los cambios en un número de condiciones mucho mayor que el que los científicos han estudiado hasta ahora, y utilizar esos datos para crear modelos predictivos que podrían acortar los plazos de desarrollo de fármacos, que actualmente duran años.
"Hasta ahora, la biología ha sido una ciencia basada en el descubrimiento", dijo Chan en una entrevista. "Siempre la hemos considerado un activo de la comunidad, no solo de un grupo, para que pueda ir creciendo con el tiempo".
Los conjuntos de datos se harán públicos con el tiempo, pero las empresas que los financian obtienen una ventaja inicial, según Alex Rives, director científico de Biohub.
"Con los financiadores comerciales tenemos períodos de embargo durante los cuales los grupos pueden trabajar con los datos, y después estos pasan a estar disponibles como recurso científico público", explicó Rives.
Este acuerdo es la forma en que Biohub está atrayendo fondos privados hacia un proyecto que describe como "ciencia abierta". Rives señaló que el trabajo financiado por el Gobierno, que se lleva a cabo en paralelo, no tendrá tales restricciones, y que Biohub tiene previsto dirigirse próximamente a empresas farmacéuticas y organizaciones filantrópicas.
Los conjuntos de datos celulares actuales abarcan cientos de millones de células, señaló Rives, mientras que un modelo predictivo preciso requerirá miles de millones y, con el tiempo, billones. El objetivo de Biohub es cerrar esa brecha.
"Tenemos que captar el lenguaje de la biología, tenemos que captar el lenguaje de la célula. Y eso no existe hoy en día", afirmó.
Los datos procederán de técnicas como la transcriptómica espacial —que cartografía la actividad molecular en el interior de tejidos intactos— y de cribados que registran cómo responden las células a los cambios en el entorno. Gran parte de ellos nunca se han generado de forma coordinada.
Rives señaló que este trabajo llevaría normalmente décadas y que los socios pretenden condensarlo en cinco años, con un primer conjunto de datos listo en aproximadamente un año. Espera contar con modelos predictivos precisos en un plazo de cinco años.
Otros laboratorios de IA están llevando a cabo iniciativas similares. Anthropic ha redoblado sus esfuerzos en el ámbito de la biología con un laboratorio de experimentación, mientras que la Fundación OpenAI ha puesto en marcha un programa de subvenciones de más de 125 millones de dólares para financiar conjuntos de datos biológicos y médicos destinados a la investigación en IA.

items.title: Revolut will cover costs for customers hit by data hack, Western Europe CEO says
items.author: Elizabeth Howcroft
items.creator: Elizabeth Howcroft
items.summary: Revolut will cover the cost of customers wanting to change their identity documents after the London-based bank was tricked into giving hackers the data of hundreds of customers, the company's CEO for Western Europe said on Wednesday.
items.body:
Revolut will cover the cost of customers wanting to change their identity documents after the London-based bank was tricked into giving hackers the data of hundreds of customers, the company's CEO for Western Europe said on Wednesday.
Revolut, Europe's [USN:L6N45R0BS TEXT:"most valuable startup"], said it had sent the customers' personal data to hackers who had taken control of an Italian government agency email address, in an incident first disclosed [USN:L1N455038 TEXT:"last month"].
Béatrice Cossa-Dumurgier, Revolut's CEO for Western Europe, told BFM TV in an interview that the company would not pay ransoms to hackers, when asked if they had paid one. Revolut[USN:L6N458127 TEXT:" previously said"] it had not received a ransom demand.
Cossa-Dumurgier said Revolut had provided assistance for the 680 affected clients, 55 of whom are in France.
"If they ever have to change their ID documents, we're taking care of the associated costs", she added, without specifying whether this had happened yet or how much it could cost the company.
Financial institutions are required to send customer data to authorities when asked to do so as part of investigations into potential crimes.
Matteo Piantedosi, Italy's interior minister, told lawmakers on September 30 that the email address to which Revolut sent customer data came from the Reggio Calabria police's email system, but was an address that had never been used before.
Revolut could have and should have verified the request by doing minimal due diligence, the minister said.
A spokesperson for Revolut declined to comment on the interior minister's remarks.
Cossa-Dumurgier said that government agencies are sometimes the "weak link" in the system and that Revolut's own systems had not been compromised.

items.title: Kremlin diz que teste da França com míssil nuclear faz parte de estratégia antirussa
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Kremlin afirmou nesta quarta-feira que o teste de lançamento de um míssil com capacidade nuclear pela França demonstrou que a Europa está construindo sua identidade de defesa em torno do confronto com a Rússia, descrevendo a estratégia como um “beco sem saída”.
items.body:
O Kremlin afirmou nesta quarta-feira que o teste de lançamento de um míssil com capacidade nuclear pela França demonstrou que a Europa está construindo sua identidade de defesa em torno do confronto com a Rússia, descrevendo a estratégia como um “beco sem saída”.
Na terça-feira, o presidente francês Emmanuel Macron elogiou o teste do míssil balístico lançado de um submarino na costa da Bretanha como uma mensagem “enviada de forma clara e inequívoca para onde quer que deva ser recebida”, sem mencionar diretamente a Rússia.
O lançamento ocorreu em meio a tensões crescentes em torno da guerra na Ucrânia, da segurança europeia e da dissuasão nuclear. A Rússia renovou recentemente as advertências de que poderia usar armas nucleares para defender a si mesma e o enclave de Kaliningrado.
Questionado sobre o teste, o porta-voz do Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, disse aos repórteres que a Rússia havia recebido a mensagem da França e afirmou que se tratava de um exemplo de obsessão da Europa pela militarização.
“Eles estão construindo sua identidade no campo da defesa e da segurança com base no confronto com a Federação Russa. Esse é um caminho sem saída. Como mostra a história, isso não leva a nada de bom”, disse.
Peskov afirmou que a Rússia permanece alerta, mas aberta ao diálogo. “Acreditamos que quaisquer problemas devem ser resolvidos não por meio de lançamentos demonstrativos de mísseis, mas por meio do diálogo”, acrescentou.

items.title: ノーベル化学賞の硤合氏、「受賞しても文句言われない」　カガン氏との栄誉に喜び
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ７日 ロイター] - ２０２６年のノーベル化学賞を受賞した硤合憲三・東京理科大名誉教授（７６）は７日、都内の同大で記者会見し、世の中には他に重要な研究が多数あると指摘しつつ、自身の成果が「受賞できても文句は言われないとは（思っていた）」と語った。「研究に対する意味合い、位置付けも今回の受賞で認識していただけた。非常に喜んでいる」と話した。

今年の化学賞は「不斉有機合成における非線形効果と自己触媒作用の発見」を理由に硤合氏と仏パリ第１１大学のアンリ・カガン氏（９５）が共同で受賞した。非対称な「鏡像」分子を巡る長年の謎を解明し、医薬品製造において重要な発見をもたらしたことが評価された。

硤合氏は、尊敬する著名なカガン氏とともに受賞したことをとりわけ喜んでいると語った上で、「暗い地面を頭にヘッドライトだけを着けて、そこをずっとたどって行っているような気分」だったとこれまでの研究を振り返った。「もちろん完全にまだ解明したわけではなく、まだまだわからない面白いことがあるはず。今後ともそういう分野の研究が進むように微力ながら尽力したい」と述べた。

また、受賞により「興味を持たれる方はもちろん、必ずしもそうほどでもなかった方にも、ちょっと気を向けていただけるじゃないかな」「日本は有機合成（研究）の非常に盛んな国。これからますます皆さんが研究成果を出していただけるきっかけになればという風に考えている」とも述べた。 

硤合氏は広島県出身。１９７９年に東京大学大学院で博士号を取得した。米ノースカロライナ大学で研究し、帰国後の１９８１年から理科大で教壇に立った。

硤合氏は「傍から見たら苦しいことが続いていたかもしれないけど、全然本人はそうは思ってない。新しい事実がどんどん見つかるわけですからね。それはそれで楽しいというか、感動したことはある」と答えた。理科大の教職員や学生などへの感謝も口にした。研究成果について問われると、幾度も手ぶりを交えて説明する姿が目立った。

一方、研究成果が実際にどういう形で応用されているのかについて問われると「応用ができるに越したことはないが、化学賞だけ皆さん、応用が何にできるかって聞かれるが、物理学賞、宇宙のことってあんまり応用って質問されませんよね。応用オンリーではないとかねがね思っている」と答えた。 日本人としての受賞についての質問には「日本人かどうかというところはあまりこだわりを持っていなくて」と話した。

受賞の連絡は、夕方から夜ごろ、近所のスーパーに１人で食材を買いに出かけている時に電話で受けたという。

（岡坂健太郎　編集：久保信博）

items.title: Report: Alex Cora declines chance to manage Phillies
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Alex Cora turned down another opportunity to manage the Philadelphia Phillies and plans to take the 2027 season off, USA Today reported Wednesday.
items.body:
Alex Cora turned down another opportunity to manage the Philadelphia Phillies and plans to take the 2027 season off, USA Today reported Wednesday.
The report's source was a "high-ranking Phillies executive with direct knowledge" of the talks between Cora and Phillies president of baseball operations Dave Dombrowski.
Philadelphia reportedly plans to part ways with interim manager Don Mattingly after falling to the Atlanta Braves in last week's National League wild-card series. Mattingly inherited a team that started 9-19 under Rob Thomson and guided them to a 79-55 mark to finish out the regular season.
The Phillies fired Rob Thomson on April 28, three days after the Boston Red Sox fired Cora following a 10-17 start.
Dombrowski said he offered the job to Cora at the time but was turned down, prompting the team to turn to Mattingly, who was in his first season as Thomson's bench coach.
"It's not the time to talk about it," Mattingly said when he was asked about his future following the elimination by the Braves. "I'm comfortable with whatever they want to do.
"I want the best for the Phillies. I loved being in Philly this year. I actually like playing in that environment. I like the environment. It's a rough environment, but it's good."
Cora, who turns 51 on Oct. 18, compiled a 620-541 record in two stints as the skipper in Boston (2018-19, 2021-26). He led the Red Sox to a World Series championship in 2018.
Mattingly, 65, has a 968-1,005 record as manager of the Los Angeles Dodgers (2011-15), Miami Marlins (2016-22) and Phillies (2026).
--Field Level Media

items.title: Core Stack e Green Arrow, progetto data center in Italia da 1 mld euro
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Core Stack, divisione del Gruppo Lazzari dedicata alle infrastrutture digitali, investirà in partnership con Green Arrow Capital oltre 1 miliardo di euro nei prossimi quattro anni per realizzare una rete di 13 data center di medie dimensioni in Italia. Lo hanno annunciato oggi le due società.
items.body:
Core Stack, divisione del Gruppo Lazzari dedicata alle infrastrutture digitali, investirà in partnership con Green Arrow Capital oltre 1 miliardo di euro nei prossimi quattro anni per realizzare una rete di 13 data center di medie dimensioni in Italia. Lo hanno annunciato oggi le due società.
I data center di medie dimensioni saranno alimentati da energia rinnovabile generata in loco.
Le società contano di ottenere le autorizzazioni necessarie per i primi due siti, nelle province di Cremona e Verona, entro la fine del 2027, con l’avvio delle operazioni previsto nel primo trimestre del 2028.
Dopo i progetti più avanzati nel nord e nel nord-est dell’Italia, l’attenzione si sposterà al centro-sud, hanno detto le società.
Lo sviluppo dei data center si avvarrà di una filiera interamente italiana, hanno precisato.

items.title: Aaron Sorkin conta por que fez mais um filme sobre Facebook e como vida real se traduz no cinema
items.author: Rollo Ross
items.creator: Rollo Ross
items.summary: Aaron Sorkin, o roteirista vencedor do Oscar por “A Rede Social”, não tinha a intenção de fazer outro filme sobre o Facebook.
items.body:
Aaron Sorkin, o roteirista vencedor do Oscar por “A Rede Social”, não tinha a intenção de fazer outro filme sobre o Facebook.
Sorkin vinha tendo dificuldades para encontrar uma ideia para um novo projeto quando conheceu Frances Haugen, uma ex-funcionária do Facebook e denunciante cujas revelações levantaram preocupações sobre o impacto das plataformas de mídia social da empresa na saúde, na segurança e na política global. A história que ele criou, contada no filme “O Outro Lado das Redes”, estreará nos cinemas neste mês.
“Eu estava procurando uma boa história e, após um período de cerca de um ano de um bloqueio criativo épico, sem conseguir pensar em nenhuma história, conheci Frances Haugen e, de repente, uma boa história começou a tomar forma na minha cabeça”, disse Sorkin, que também dirigiu o filme, em entrevista à Reuters.
“A Rede Social”, lançado em 2010, contava a história da origem do Facebook — que, desde então, mudou seu nome para Meta (META.O) — e tinha Jesse Eisenberg no papel do fundador Mark Zuckerberg.
O novo filme gira em torno de Haugen e do jornalista Jeff Horwitz, que escreveu uma série para o Wall Street Journal chamada “The Facebook Files”, iniciada em 2021 e baseada em grande parte nos milhares de documentos internos que ela lhe forneceu.
“É uma história de Davi e Golias, mas há dois Davis”, disse Sorkin. “Um deles é Frances. Ela pega uma pedra e a arremessa contra o Facebook, e o outro é o jornalismo impresso. Eles pegam uma pedra e a arremessam contra o setor de tecnologia.”
Horwitz, que posteriormente detalhou a história em seu livro de 2023, “Broken Code”, agora trabalha como repórter investigativo para a Reuters e continuou cobrindo a Meta, ganhando este ano o Prêmio Pulitzer na categoria de reportagem de cobertura especializada junto com o colega Engen Tham por reportagens que expuseram como a Meta permitiu que seus chatbots se envolvessem em comportamentos provocativos e arrecadassem bilhões de dólares em receita com anúncios fraudulentos.
A Sony Pictures (6758.T) comprou os direitos sobre a história de sua vida em conexão com suas reportagens anteriores sobre o Facebook, quando trabalhava no Wall Street Journal. “O Outro Lado das Redes” é um relato ficcionalizado dos eventos e não se baseia nas reportagens de Horwitz sobre o Facebook, o Instagram ou a Meta desde que ele ingressou na Reuters em 2025.
O filme narra os encontros de Haugen com Horwitz a partir de dezembro de 2020 e sua relutância em se manifestar publicamente. Haugen acaba concluindo que as revelações terão mais impacto se seu nome for divulgado e decide falar oficialmente. Ela também testemunha perante o Congresso para explicar como acreditava que o algoritmo do Facebook estava promovendo conteúdo que gerava divisão em busca de lucros.
Um porta-voz da Meta se recusou a comentar sobre o filme.
Quando Haugen prestou depoimento, o Facebook afirmou que a empresa discordava de sua descrição de como funcionava. Zuckerberg defendeu a empresa em uma postagem no Facebook, escrevendo que “o argumento de que promovemos deliberadamente conteúdo que irrita as pessoas para obter lucro é profundamente ilógico”.
Em agosto, a Meta concordou em pagar até US$18 bilhões na próxima década para limitar estritamente o uso do Facebook e do Instagram por adolescentes, conforme um acordo com os Estados dos EUA. A empresa negou qualquer irregularidade e afirmou que garantir que os adolescentes tenham uma “experiência segura e produtiva em nossas plataformas” é um “imperativo absoluto” para a empresa.
Embora Horwitz não tenha se envolvido na produção do filme e não tivesse voz ativa sobre seu conteúdo, ele se reuniu com Sorkin e respondeu às perguntas dele sobre o processo de reportagem e sua relação com Haugen. Segundo Horwitz, Sorkin disse que usaria alguma liberdade artística.
“Ele me disse que achava que precisaria alterar um pouco a cronologia e alguns detalhes para que a história que tinha em mente funcionasse”, declarou Horwitz, que só leu o roteiro depois que ele ficou pronto. “Ele também me disse que queria tomar algumas liberdades com o ‘Jeff do filme’, que seria uma espécie de personagem fictício, uma síntese de repórteres investigativos. Definitivamente, seria uma situação do tipo ‘inspirado em, não baseado em’.”
Sorkin disse que os principais fatos da história são precisos, embora ele tenha precisado criar diálogos e uma linha do tempo para construir uma narrativa cinematográfica envolvente.

items.title: African Union delegation meets Congo rebels, calls for continued peace efforts
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: An African Union delegation that met Rwanda-backed rebels in eastern Congo has called for continued engagement in the peace process, as fighting continues despite ongoing mediation efforts.
items.body:
An African Union delegation that met Rwanda-backed rebels in eastern Congo has called for continued engagement in the peace process, as fighting continues despite ongoing mediation efforts.
The delegation, which includes three former presidents, Kenya's Uhuru Kenyatta, Ethiopia's Sahle-Work Zewde and Botswana's Mokgweetsi Masisi, met leaders of the AFC/M23 rebel group on Monday, the African Union said in a statement on Wednesday
The rebels control large areas of North and South Kivu provinces captured during a lightning offensive last year
Congo's government and AFC/M23 signed a declaration in Doha in July 2025, committing to a permanent ceasefire and negotiations towards a broader peace agreement
The process has yielded limited progress, including the [USN:L8N4440KH TEXT:"release"] of detainees in August and the recent [USN:L6N44L0IT TEXT:"deployment"] of teams responsible for observing implementation of the ceasefire
Yet fighting has continued, with recent clashes concentrated in remote parts of South Kivu's highlands and North Kivu's Masisi territory
Parallel mediation efforts involving Congo and Rwanda have also been led by the United States and the African Union, but have so far brought little change on the ground
The delegation called for respect of commitments made in Doha, adherence to the ceasefire and cooperation with verification mechanisms
It also stressed the need to protect civilians and ensure safe humanitarian access
The delegation met with Rwanda's foreign minister on Tuesday and is expected in Kinshasa for consultations with the Congolese government

items.title: Un palestino muere en ataque de colonos israelíes durante cosecha de aceitunas, dicen fuentes oficiales
items.author: Mohammed Torokman
items.creator: Mohammed Torokman
items.summary: Un palestino murió el miércoles durante un ataque perpetrado por colonos israelíes mientras unas personas recolectaban aceitunas cerca de la localidad de Burqa, en la Cisjordania ocupada por Israel, informó el Ministerio de Salud palestino.
items.body:
Un palestino murió el miércoles durante un ataque perpetrado por colonos israelíes mientras unas personas recolectaban aceitunas cerca de la localidad de Burqa, en la Cisjordania ocupada por Israel, informó el Ministerio de Salud palestino.
El ataque se produjo en medio de una escalada de violencia por parte de colonos israelíes radicales durante la cosecha de aceitunas palestina, en la que los colonos han disparado munición real contra los agricultores, han agredido a periodistas y han dañado los árboles.
El Ejército israelí dijo que tanto soldados como colonos habían abierto fuego en el incidente del miércoles. Según el Ejército, los soldados respondieron a un aviso de que un palestino había lanzado una piedra contra un colono, pero no explicó por qué se encontraban los colonos en la zona.
Periodistas de Reuters han sido testigos de varios incidentes en las últimas dos semanas en los que el Ejército israelí y los colonos han impedido a los palestinos acceder a sus olivares.
El Ministerio de Salud palestino identificó al fallecido como Ali Hassan Yusor al-Bazzari, de 44 años. No quedó claro de inmediato si lo había matado el Ejército israelí o los colonos.
En el funeral celebrado tras el ataque, el hijo de al-Bazzari, Danial, de 12 años, lloró junto al cadáver de su padre, que posteriormente fue cubierto con una bandera palestina.
"PARA NOSOTROS, EL OLIVO ES LA VIDA" La cosecha de aceitunas, que se extiende de octubre a noviembre, se ha producido en medio de un recrudecimiento de la violencia en Cisjordania, donde los colonos israelíes han matado al menos a 30 palestinos este año, según la Autoridad Palestina.
También se ha informado de que más de 45.000 árboles, entre ellos más de 26.000 olivos, fueron talados o dañados en toda Cisjordania durante el primer semestre de 2026.
Los olivos revisten una gran importancia para los palestinos, ya que representan su vínculo con la tierra y constituyen una fuente vital de ingresos, en un contexto de crecientes presiones económicas.
"Para nosotros, el olivo es la vida", dijo Tayseer Al-Sheikh, un agricultor palestino de 64 años, de las afueras de la aldea de Rantis, al noroeste de Ramala.
El miedo a la violencia de los colonos le impidió acceder a sus olivos y cuidarlos durante un año. Solo pudo acceder a ellos en esta cosecha, acompañado por activistas que le proporcionaban protección.
Para Al-Sheikh, la pérdida no se mide únicamente por el número de árboles o la cantidad de aceite producido, sino también por el cambio en la relación de las personas con su tierra.
"Antes, todo el mundo solía venir a recoger aceitunas, tanto jóvenes como mayores. Hoy en día, mucha gente tiene miedo de acercarse a sus tierras", dijo a Reuters.

items.title: Stretto di Hormuz, 'rotte illegali' presto chiuse - funzionario Iran
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
items.body:
Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
15.20 - Le rotte di transito nello Stretto di Hormuz ritenute illegali dall’Iran verranno presto chiuse.
Lo ha comunicato un consigliere del comandante delle Guardie Rivoluzionarie all’agenzia di stampa semi-ufficiale Fars News Agency, riferendosi alla rotta meridionale che costeggia il litorale dell'Oman.
Mohammadreza Naqdi ha detto che queste "poche rotte" sono state create facendo saltare in aria e danneggiando alcuni dei passaggi rocciosi della via d'acqua strategica e vengono utilizzate da "piccole imbarcazioni che contrabbandano petrolio e lo trasferiscono alle petroliere", contestando la tesi secondo cui le esportazioni di greggio del Golfo starebbero tornando ai livelli pre-bellici.
"Lo Stretto di Hormuz è chiuso e le forze armate della Repubblica Islamica iraniana ne hanno il pieno controllo. Questa situazione continuerà finché le legittime richieste dell’Iran non saranno soddisfatte", ha aggiunto.
13.15 - Gli Houthi yemeniti hanno attaccato l'aeroporto internazionale di Aden con missili balistici e droni carichi di esplosivo.
Lo ha comunicato il ministero dei Trasporti del Paese, mentre si intensificano gli scontri tra il gruppo filoiraniano e le forze governative sostenute dall'Arabia Saudita.
La coalizione a guida saudita ha detto di aver intercettato e distrutto un missile balistico Houthi a nord della capitale saudita Riyadh e di star monitorando la piattaforma di lancio a Sanaa, controllata dagli Houthi, che sarebbe stata distrutta, senza tuttavia fornire dettagli su eventuali vittime o danni.
Il portavoce militare degli Houthi, Yahya Saree, ha detto in un comunicato che il gruppo ha preso di mira l'aeroporto internazionale Re Khalid di Riyadh con diversi droni.
L'Arabia Saudita non ha rilasciato alcuna conferma immediata riguardo all'attacco all'aeroporto.

items.title: L'OMS demande plus d'informations à Moscou sur le décès d'une employée d'un institut dédié à la peste
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'Organisation mondiale de la santé a déclaré mercredi avoir demandé à la Russie davantage d'informations sur les causes du décès d'une employée d'un institut spécialisé dans la peste en Sibérie, soulignant que la transparence était essentielle pour se faire une idée précise des risques sanitaires potentiels.
items.body:
L'Organisation mondiale de la santé a déclaré mercredi avoir demandé à la Russie davantage d'informations sur les causes du [USN:L6N45R0QR TEXT:"décès d'une employé"]e d'un institut spécialisé dans la peste en Sibérie, soulignant que la transparence était essentielle pour se faire une idée précise des risques sanitaires potentiels.
Les autorités russes affirment que cette employée de laboratoire âgée de 28 ans est décédée vendredi d'une pneumonie dont l'origine n'a pas encore été établie, dans une affaire qui a suscité l'inquiétude de la communauté internationale, notamment du président américain Donald Trump, et qui a conduit à la mise en quarantaine initiale d'environ 200 personnes.
L'agence russe de surveillance sanitaire a déclaré mardi qu'[USN:L8N45S14O TEXT:"aucun cas de peste"] n'avait été détecté parmi les personnes ayant été en contact avec la défunte, Darya Shipilova, et un responsable local a indiqué que 60% des personnes placées en quarantaine avaient été autorisées à quitter celle-ci.
Mais Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, directeur général de l'OMS, basé à Genève, a déclaré dans un communiqué publié sur X que son organisation avait besoin de plus d'informations de la part de la Russie pour comprendre pleinement ce qui s'est passé.
"L'OMS a demandé des informations complémentaires afin de clarifier la cause de cette pneumonie grave, l'agent pathogène à l'origine des mesures de santé publique, ainsi que les informations relayées par les médias concernant un deuxième employé atteint d'une pneumonie d'origine indéterminée", a-t-il déclaré.
Certains médias occidentaux ont rapporté - en citant des "médias russes" anonymes - qu'une deuxième personne était décédée en Sibérie, affirmant qu'elle était morte de la peste. Reuters n'a trouvé aucune information de ce type dans les médias russes ni aucune preuve qu’une deuxième personne soit décédée en Sibérie.
Néanmoins, la demande de Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus sur un complément d'information fait écho à celle du secrétaire d’État américain Marco Rubio, qui a déclaré que Moscou devait communiquer davantage sur cet incident.
Si l'autorité sanitaire russe a dit que Darya Shipilova était décédée des suites d'une pneumonie, elle n'a pas expliqué publiquement quelle en était la cause ni comment elle était tombée malade. La pneumonie peut avoir diverses causes, dont la peste.
La Russie a informé l'Organisation mondiale de la santé du décès d'un employé de laboratoire dans un institut de recherche sur la peste en Sibérie la semaine dernière, conformément aux procédures en vigueur, a déclaré mercredi le porte-parole du Kremlin, Dmitri Peskov.
Ce dernier a accusé les médias de diffuser de fausses informations sur cette affaire.
Il a notamment réagi à un reportage d'ABC News selon lequel les États-Unis avaient déposé une plainte diplomatique officielle concernant la manière dont la Russie avait géré ce décès, exhortant Moscou à faire preuve d'une plus grande transparence sur cet incident.
Le porte-parole du Kremlin a déclaré que la plupart des informations relayées au sujet de cet incident étaient fausses et que la population devait se fier aux informations communiquées par l'agence nationale de surveillance sanitaire Rospotrebnadzor.
Dmitri Peskov a précisé qu'aucun entretien téléphonique n'était prévu pour l'instant entre le président russe Vladimir Poutine et Donald Trump, qui a déclaré mardi qu'il s'entretiendrait "très prochainement" avec Vladimor Poutine à ce sujet.
