items.title: South Korea denies Ukrainian report that it eased Russia's fuel crisis
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: South Korea's presidential office on Wednesday dismissed a Ukrainian report that Russia has imported petroleum products from South Korean ports, calling the accusation inappropriate.
items.body:
South Korea's presidential office on Wednesday dismissed a [USN:L8N45S1BB TEXT:"Ukrainian report"] that Russia has imported petroleum products from South Korean ports, calling the accusation inappropriate.
Ukraine's top sanctions official, Vladyslav Vlasiuk, said on Tuesday the shipments had eased the impact of a fuel crisis caused by Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries.
His comment followed a report by the Guardian newspaper saying that port records and ship-tracking data showed that fuel had been loaded at South Korean ports onto seven tankers, including vessels under British and EU sanctions.
The presidential office said South Korea had "consistently enforced sanctions and export controls against Russia in close coordination with the international community," since Moscow's invasion of Ukraine .
It added that Seoul was examining the facts and checking for any export control issues, and would take necessary measures if any problems were confirmed.

items.title: 独、テスラの運転支援システムのＥＵ承認を推進　マスク氏が歓迎
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Marie Mannes　Miranda Murray

[ベルリン ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Marie Mannes　Miranda Murray

[ベルリン ７日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は７日、同社の運転支援システム「フルセルフドライビング」に対するドイツ政府の支持を歓迎した。同氏は、交通安全の専門家らが「安全性の主張が誇張されている」と警告する「フルセルフドライビング」について、欧州全域での承認を目指している。

マスク氏は、ドイツのビルガー交通相が欧州全域での「フルセルフドライビング」の承認を推進していることを受け、Ｘにドイツ語で「ありがとう」と投稿した。

ビルガー氏は６日の声明で、先月にテスラと数多くの技術的詳細や責任問題について協議した結果、「フルセルフドライビング」のＥＵによる迅速な承認を提唱していると述べた。

協議の一環で、ドイツはテスラと、「フルセルフドライビング」で制限速度を最大１０％まで超過してもよいことで合意した。速度超過が主な争点の一つとなっている欧州の承認プロセスにおいても、ドイツはこのアプローチを支持する方針だ。

一方、交通安全の専門家や一部の規制当局は、テスラが採用している「速度オフセット機能」（システムが制限速度を超えて走行することを可能にする機能）は、欧州での承認前に削除されるべきだと主張している。

ビルガー氏はまた、システム名が多少誤解を招くという懸念に対処するため、テスラがシステム名を「テスラ・アシスト・ドライビング」に変更することを提案したと明らかにした。同システムは運転を支援するものではあるが、完全な自動運転ではない。

フルセルフドライビングはすでにオランダやベルギーなど欧州の一部で認可されている。

しかし、スウェーデンやフランスを含むいくつかのＥＵ加盟国は、同システムが制限速度を超えることへの懸念を表明しており、１０月に予定されていたＥＵの採決は、一部の国が追加試験を行う間、少なくとも１２月まで延期された。

items.title: Nasdaq, S&P 500 slip from record highs as yields and oil rebound
items.author: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Shashwat Chauhan
items.creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Shashwat Chauhan
items.summary: The Nasdaq and the S&P 500 eased from record highs on Wednesday as Treasury yields and oil prices rebounded, keeping investors cautious as they awaited the minutes of the Federal Reserve's September meeting.
items.body:
The Nasdaq and the S&P 500 eased from record highs on Wednesday as Treasury yields and oil prices rebounded, keeping investors cautious as they awaited the minutes of the Federal Reserve's September meeting.
Sentiment turned more cautious as investors reassessed the outlook for interest rates and energy costs. Brent crude was back above the psychologically important $100-a-barrel level as Middle East supply concerns persisted.
"We're seeing a little bit of profit-taking today. The market is very focused on the Fed minutes, but ultimately it's where oil prices and yields move that will determine the market's direction today," said Peter Cardillo, chief market economist at Spartan Capital Securities.
Chip stocks were among the top decliners. Memory chip firm Micron Technology (MU.O) dropped 2.3%, chip giant Nvidia (NVDA.O) eased 0.7% and the broader Philadelphia chip index (.SOX) fell 2.3%.
Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPCX.O) lost 1.7% after a Financial Times report that [USN:L6N45S1CR TEXT:"the rockets-to-AI firm"] was seeking $40 billion in financing to fund purchases of Nvidia chips.
Eight of the 11 S&P 500 sectors traded lower, with the materials (.SPLRCM) and industrials (.SPLRCI) leading losses.
Energy (.SPNY) and healthcare (.SPXHC) were higher, up 0.6% each.
At 9:43 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) fell 472.21 points, or 0.92%, to 51,049.07, the S&P 500 (.SPX) lost 44.80 points, or 0.56%, to 7,775.04 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) lost 235.16 points, or 0.85%, to 27,364.73.
The yield on 30-year Treasury bonds rose to the highest since 2002, last at 5.72% ahead of the release later in the day of [USN:L6N45S0TH TEXT:"minutes from the US Federal Reserve's"] September policy meeting, when policymakers raised interest rates to combat inflation.
Traders widely expect the Fed to hold rates steady at its October meeting, but a December hike remains on the cards, according to the CME FedWatch Tool.
The S&P 500's equal-weighted counterpart (.SPXEW) , meanwhile, stands more than 5% away from record highs and the interest-rate-sensitive Russell 2000 small-cap index (.RUT) is down more than 8% from its all-time high.
MARKETS BRACE FOR EARNINGS Focus will likely shift to how corporate America is faring as the third-quarter earnings season kicks off next week, with a number of high-profile financial firms expected to report on Tuesday.
US stocks have been buoyed lately by optimism around the AI trade and expectations of strong corporate earnings, despite higher energy prices and a summer selloff in bond markets that fueled concerns about tighter monetary policy.
Analysts currently expect S&P 500 earnings growth of 30.6%, in aggregate, for the July-to-September period, led by an expected 114.7% jump in energy earnings, followed by a 66.5% estimated surge in tech results, according to LSEG.
While the 30% profit growth is smaller than in the second quarter, when S&P 500 companies posted a 54% jump in earnings, investors expect a largely positive season to underpin record-high stock markets.
Among other movers, Roblox fell 1.6% after Google and Unity announced a partnership on a new AI gaming platform that could compete with the [USN:L4N45T0W0 TEXT:"gaming platform's"] offerings.
Declining issues outnumbered advancers by a 3.74-to-1 ratio on the NYSE and by a 3.19-to-1 ratio on the Nasdaq.
The S&P 500 posted 8 new 52-week highs and 5 new lows, while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 8 new highs and 129 new lows.

items.title: Morning Bid: Storm brewing
items.author: Mike Dolan
items.creator: Mike Dolan
items.summary: As the US third-quarter earnings season gets set to kick off, Wall Street's S&P 500 joined the Nasdaq in setting a new record high on Tuesday - its first in about six weeks.
items.body:
As the US third-quarter earnings season gets set to kick off, Wall Street's S&P 500 joined the Nasdaq in [USN:L6N45S0IV TEXT:"setting a new record high"] on Tuesday - its first in about six weeks.
Consensus forecasts are for another AI-led blockbuster rise in profits in the July-September period, with LSEG data showing expectations of an overall 30% annual expansion.
With Treasury yields still hovering [USN:L4N45T003 TEXT:"close to 24-year highs"], bond markets are navigating another heavy week of US debt sales. Tuesday's auction of 3-year notes appeared to go relatively smoothly, unlike last month's jarring 5-year sale, but the rates taken up were still their highest in 20 years.
Sales of 10-year and 30-year paper will follow today and tomorrow, respectively.
Even though the rise in Federal Reserve interest rate expectations has largely been responsible for the surge in Treasury yields over recent months, the risk premium that accounts for investor uncertainty about holding long-term debt to maturity is also back on the rise.
The New York Fed's estimate of the 10-year Treasury "term premium", which feeds off long-term debt and inflation concerns, has climbed to its highest in 12 years this week at 96 basis points.
Helping gauge the next steps from the Fed, the central bank will release minutes of its September meeting on Wednesday - a readout on what was said to be a [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"unanimous decision"] to lift rates for the first time in three years.
In the background, the Atlanta Fed's real-time GDPNow model eased a bit to 3.7% from as high as 5.1% previously - although this may be partly related to mechanical GDP impact from a [USN:L1N45R0RR TEXT:"rising trade deficit"] in August. That, though, was in turn driven largely by a jump in imports that speaks as much to stepped-up activity and the AI boom.
In Europe, French and other euro zone government debt markets [USN:L6N45S0DI TEXT:"calmed somewhat"] on Tuesday, with one eye on the [USN:L8N45R1J6 TEXT:"spending cut plans"] of far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen, who's now the favorite to win the April election.
Chart of the day
French government debt risk premia versus Germany surged last month to the widest in 15 years, as the country struggles again to pass an [USN:L1N45N09R TEXT:"annual budget"] that would keep a lid on its annual deficit of more than 5% of GDP as debt piles soar.
The widening of French debt spreads and rising nominal borrowing costs have sent a jolt through all [USN:L8N45S0RJ TEXT:"euro zone government debt markets"], given the outside chance it seeds a repeat of the existential euro debt crisis of 2010-2012. Belgian, Italian and Greek debt markets felt most of the spillover last month.
Today's events to watch
US 10-year note auction (1 p.m. EDT)
Fed publishes September policy meeting minutes (2 p.m. EDT)

items.body:
[アテネ ７日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は７日、米国と「北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の強力かつ模範的な同盟国」であるギリシャが法執行機関間で新たなテロ対策情報の共有を開始すると表明した。

アテネを公式訪問中のルビオ氏は、ギリシャは特に大規模な移民や人身売買による脅威にさらされていると述べた。

ギリシャのゲラペトリティス外相と並んで記者団に対し、「両国に共通するこれらの脅威と闘う取り組みの一環として、それぞれの法執行機関間のテロ対策情報共有を強化する共同安全保障プログラムを確立する新たな覚書を締結したことを、誇りを持って発表する」と語った。

ゲラペトリティス氏は、ホルムズ海峡で実行可能な和平プロセスが進めば、ギリシャは米国と協力し、同海峡での海上支援を提供する用意があると述べた。

ギルフォイル駐ギリシャ米大使が「米国は影響力を行使してギリシャ政府を弱体化させることができる」と脅したとの疑惑について米上院議員らが懸念を表明したことを巡っては、ルビオ氏は同大使を擁護。「ここにあるわれわれの大使館は素晴らしい仕事をしている。われわれの大使はこの地で力強い大使としての役割を果たしている」と述べた。

items.title: TSX falls as rising yields pressure financials, miners
items.author: Avinash P, Anand R
items.creator: Avinash P, Anand R
items.summary: Canada's benchmark stock index slipped to near one-week low on Wednesday, with miners and financials leading losses, as elevated oil prices and climbing yields stoked inflationary fears and soured risk appetite.
items.body:
Canada's benchmark stock index slipped to near one-week low on Wednesday, with miners and financials leading losses, as elevated oil prices and climbing yields stoked inflationary fears and soured risk appetite.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) fell 1.33% to 35,174.22 points at 10:08 a.m. ET (1408 GMT), touching its lowest since October 1.
Gold fell 1.6% to a two-month low, pressured by a strong US dollar and Treasury yields
Materials sector (.GSPTTMT) , which includes precious metal miners, declined 2.7% to its lowest level in two months
Brent crude prices rose 1.1% to $101.68 a barrel, reinforcing expectations of higher interest rates
"Of late, bond yields have been the big driver of performance of our (Canadian) market," said Matthew Kempton, portfolio manager at Verecan Capital Management
"When interest rates move higher, it can be quite poor for [financials'] core business, especially with the yield curve becoming flatter and spreads getting smaller," Kempton said
The heavily weighted financials (.SPTTFS) slipped 1.7%; Royal Bank of Canada (RY.TO) and Toronto-Dominion Bank (TD.TO) fell more than 1.7% each
Yields on the US benchmark 10-year Treasury note and 30-year Treasury note climbed to their highest levels since 2002 at 5.3177% and 5.6971%, respectively
The yield on the Canadian 10-year government bond also inched higher
Markets will now eye minutes from the US Federal Reserve's September meeting later on Wednesday for clues on the monetary policy path
Traders expect the Fed to keep interest rates unchanged at its October meeting and an 86% chance of a quarter-point rate hike in December, according to data compiled by LSEG
In Canada, investors are pricing in at least one 25-basis-point hike by the central bank by year-end

items.title: 独ポルシェ、販売減前提に事業再構築　最高価格帯に注力
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Rachel More　Ilona Wissenbach

[ベルリン／フランクフルト ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Rachel More　Ilona Wissenbach

[ベルリン／フランクフルト ７日 ロイター] - ドイツの高級スポーツカーメーカー、ポルシェは７日、販売台数の減少を前提に事業を再構築すると明らかにした。需要が低迷する中でも、高級モデルへの注力で利益率の回復を目指す。

再建計画では、将来の損益分岐点となる販売台数を２０万台未満に引き下げる方針を示した。昨年の総納車台数２７万９４４９台を大幅に下回る水準となる。

ポルシェの世界納車台数は上場を果たした２０２２年から既に１０％近く減少した。中国での需要急減と米国の関税が打撃となっている。

南西部バイザッハの開発センターで開いた投資家向け説明会で、ミヒャエル・ライタース最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「９１１」などの高級スポーツカーに注力することで経営を立て直せると訴えた。年間販売の最高価格帯にある１万台について、販売価格の引き上げを目指す。

「世界で最も魅力的なスポーツカーメーカーとしてのポルシェの地位を強化したい」と述べ、ブランド価値の面でフェラーリやルイ・ヴィトンと肩を並べる存在に位置付けた。

＜２桁の利益率回復へ険しい道のり＞

ライタース氏は当面コスト削減に重点を置くと説明した。

ポルシェは今回の戦略で、グループ営業利益率の長期目標を１５％に設定した。おおむね５年以内を指す中期では、１０─１５％を目指す。利益率は上場した４年前の１０％台後半から、２５年には１．１％に急低下した。

発表を受けて株価は３．２％上昇した。

ライタース氏によると、現状では中期目標の下限を達成する見通しだ。それ以上の改善には、一段と踏み込んだ事業再編か「より好ましい事業環境」が必要になるという。

同氏は既存の人員削減策や管理職を４０％減らす計画に加え、開発費と販売費の削減で経営基盤を強化すると述べた。コスト削減に向け、同じフォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）傘下の高級車メーカー、アウディとの車台共用も拡大する方針だ。

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 7 : Microsoft will unveil on Wednesday a new laptop powered by Nvidia's chips, seeking to turn Windows into a platform for AI agents to handle tasks such as writing code without having to access the cloud, analysts said.
For Microsoft, the move represents a bet that some work that currently takes place in its costly Azure cloud computing data centers can be shifted to high-powered Windows machines in businesses and homes, a market where the Redmond, Washington-based firm retains a stronghold — and where its customers foot the hardware bills. It is a market opportunity that longtime rival Apple is also chasing with new Mac computers.
For Nvidia, cracking the Windows PC market could help it go after one of the last major markets dominated by its longtime rivals Intel and Advanced Micro Devices.
The Microsoft-hosted event in San Francisco, which the company billed as an update on its Windows operating system and Surface line of hardware, will be the culmination of years of work between the flagship operating system maker for PCs and the AI chip company to bring many tasks such as writing computer code or tackling complex business projects directly to desktops and laptops with Nvidia's RTX Spark chips announced in June.

Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will take the stage to introduce the Surface Laptop Ultra, as the new machine will be called.
One of the key challenges for Microsoft and Nvidia will be to show that agents, the long-running AI systems that can tackle complex problems on their own, can be safely contained on personal computers. Nvidia is already trying to prevent a repeat of the hack of AI hub Hugging Face, while Apple is looking to tighten up the process for giving AI agents full access to a Mac computer's hard drive.
But analysts said the biggest question will be the price of the new offerings after a memory-chip crunch has driven up prices for desktop and laptop machines.
When Microsoft originally pitched the idea of running AI tasks on PCs two years ago to save on costs, the laptops were mostly priced below $2,000, but in recent weeks, Nvidia increased the price of an AI desktop machine called the DGX Spark by about 75 per cent to $6,950, thanks to the surging costs of its 128 gigabytes of memory.
Anshel Sag, an analyst at Moor Insights & Strategy, told Reuters that the memory prices are affecting both Apple and Microsoft's efforts.
Two years ago, "the software wasn't ready, but the hardware was. Now the software is ready and the hardware is too expensive to actually run it locally," Sag said. "So it's becoming this thing where only the people who have the budget can really afford to run AI locally."

items.title: 米有権者の過半数、政権・議会は「ＡＩのリスク深刻視せず」＝調査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Courtney Rozen　Jason Lange

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Courtney Rozen　Jason Lange

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] - ロイター／イプソスの最新の世論調査によると、米有権者の過半数はトランプ政権と議会が人工知能（ＡＩ）のリスクを十分に深刻に受け止めていないと考えており、政府による新たな規制の策定を求めている。

調査は５日までの６日間実施。登録有権者３５２６人を含む成人４５０６人から回答を得た。

調査に回答した登録有権者の約５７％は、トランプ政権がＡＩのリスクを十分に深刻に受け止めていない、もしくは全く深刻に受け止めていないと答えた。共和党支持を自認する人でも３分の１が同様の見方を示した。議会のＡＩへの姿勢についても約５４％が同じ回答をした。

調査では、有権者の８４％がＡＩを米国の労働者にとって脅威と見なした。不法移民を米労働者に対する脅威だと回答したのは６０％だった。

ＡＩに対する政府の規制強化には党派を超えた過半数の有権者が賛成し、民主党支持者では８０％、共和党支持者でも６１％に上った。

ＡＩエージェントが暴走して企業のネットワークに不正侵入したとの報道や、ＡＩがいずれ人類の存続を脅かしかねないなどとする著名研究者の警告を受けて、ＡＩへの国民の関心は高まっており、１１月３日の中間選挙でも重要な争点となっている。

items.title: Ten injured in knife attack at Polish school
items.author: Anna Wlodarczak-semczuk, Pawel Florkiewicz
items.creator: Anna Wlodarczak-semczuk, Pawel Florkiewicz
items.summary: Ten people were injured in a knife attack at a school in Ostroleka in northeastern Poland on Wednesday, a regional governor said, with police detaining the 19-year-old suspect, who was among those hurt, shortly after the incident.
items.body:
Ten people were injured in a knife attack at a school in Ostroleka in northeastern Poland on Wednesday, a regional governor said, with police detaining the 19-year-old suspect, who was among those hurt, shortly after the incident.
Masovian Regional Governor Mariusz Frankowski told reporters that nine people had been taken to hospital but that none of them was in a life-threatening condition.
"The injured included five students, two teachers, and two bystanders, as well as the perpetrator, who inflicted self-harm," he said.
Police said the suspect was a student at the school and that he had attacked people with a machete. They confirmed that bomb disposal experts were checking the attacker's backpack but were unable to say if anything had been found.
STUDENTS BARRICADED THEMSELVES IN CLASSROOMS The attack took place at a vocational school for teenagers.
Fire brigade spokesperson Adrian Stupski told state news channel TVP Info that students had barricaded themselves into classrooms in self-defence before they were evacuated.
Authorities said the attack happened around 0900 GMT.
Police said they detained the suspect about 20 minutes after the attack and posted a photo on X showing a man they appeared to have apprehended lying face down in a wooded area.
Town hall spokesperson Katarzyna Ogniewska told reporters that all schools in Ostroleka were closed and that children were safe.
The motives behind the attack were unclear. Such incidents are rare in Poland, but in September police detained a 13-year-old suspected of planning an attack and found a knife in his bag.
(This story has been corrected to clarify that it was the regional governor who spoke, not Ostroleka mayor Pawel Niewiadomski, in paragraph 2.)

items.author: Rollo Ross
items.creator: Rollo Ross
items.summary: Aaron Sorkin, the Oscar-winning screenwriter of "The Social Network," had been struggling to find an idea for a new project when he met Frances Haugen, a former Facebook employee and whistleblower.
items.body:
Aaron Sorkin, the Oscar-winning screenwriter of "The Social Network," wasn't looking to make another movie about Facebook.
Sorkin had been struggling to find an idea for a new project when he met [USN:L1N30T1LO TEXT:"Frances Haugen"], a former Facebook employee and whistleblower whose disclosures raised concerns about the impact on health, safety and global politics of the company's social media platforms. The story he crafted, told in the film "The Social Reckoning," will debut in theaters on Friday.
"I was looking for a good story, and after a period of about a year of just epic writer's block, of not being able to come up with any story, I met Frances Haugen, and suddenly a good story started to take shape in my head," Sorkin, who also directed the movie, said in an interview with Reuters.
"The Social Network," released in 2010, told the origin story of Facebook, which has since changed its name to Meta (META.O) , and starred Jesse Eisenberg as founder Mark Zuckerberg.
The new movie centers on Haugen and journalist Jeff Horwitz , who wrote a series for the Wall Street Journal called "The Facebook Files" that began in 2021 and was based largely on thousands of internal documents that she provided to him.
"It is a David and Goliath story, but there are two Davids," Sorkin said. "One is Frances. She picks up a rock and throws it at Facebook, and the other is print journalism. They pick up a rock and they throw it at tech."
Horwitz, who later detailed the story in his 2023 book "Broken Code," now works as an investigative reporter for Reuters and remained on the Meta beat, earning a Pulitzer Prize in beat reporting this year with colleague Engen Tham for reports that exposed how Meta permitted its chatbots to engage in provocative behavior and earned billions of dollars in revenue from fraudulent ads.
Sony Pictures (6758.T) bought the rights to his life story in connection to his previous Facebook reporting when employed by the Wall Street Journal. "The Social Reckoning" is a fictionalized account of events, and it does not draw upon Horwitz's reporting about Facebook, Instagram or Meta since he joined Reuters in 2025.
The film chronicles Haugen's meetings with Horwitz starting in December 2020 and her reluctance to go public. Haugen eventually concludes the revelations will be more powerful with her name attached and decides to speak on the record. She also [USN:L1N2R02VT TEXT:"testifies before Congress"] to explain how she believed Facebook's algorithm was boosting divisive content in pursuit of profits.
A Meta spokesperson declined to comment on the film.
When Haugen testified, Facebook said [USN:L1N2R02VT TEXT:"the company disagreed with her characterization"] of how it operated. Zuckerberg defended the company in a Facebook post, writing that "the argument that we deliberately push content that makes people angry for profit is deeply illogical."
In August, Meta [USN:L6N44N0VA TEXT:"agreed to pay up to $18 billion"] over the next decade to strictly limit how teenagers use Facebook and Instagram under a settlement with US states. The company denied wrongdoing and said ensuring that teens have a "safe and productive experience on our platforms" was an "absolute imperative" for the company.
'WHAT I DO IS A PAINTING' While Horwitz wasn't involved in the film's production and had no say over its content, he did meet with Sorkin and answered his questions about the reporting process and his relationship with Haugen. According to Horwitz, Sorkin said he would use some artistic license.
"He told me that he thought he'd need to change some chronology and details to make the story he had in mind work," said Horwitz, who did not read the script until it was finished. "He also told me that he wanted to take some liberties with 'Movie Jeff,' who was sort of going to be a fictionalized, investigative reporter composite. It was definitely going to be an 'inspired by, not based on' situation."
Sorkin said major facts of the story are accurate, although he had to create conversations and a timeline to make a compelling cinematic narrative.
"People don't live their lives in a series of scenes that form a narrative by the end. People don't speak in dialogue. Those are things that screenwriters do," Sorkin said.
"What you do as a journalist, that's a photograph," he added. "What I do is a painting."
Zuckerberg, a supporting character in "The Social Reckoning," is played this time by "Succession" actor Jeremy Strong. Eisenberg declined the chance to reprise the role. "The Bear" star Jeremy Allen White portrays Horwitz, and Haugen is played by Mikey Madison, who won an Oscar for her role in "Anora."

items.title: Most Republicans in tight midterm races distance themselves from Trump, Reuters review finds
items.author: Nathan Layne, David Morgan
items.creator: Nathan Layne, David Morgan
items.summary: Reuters reviewed voting records, public statements and campaign materials.
items.body:
Two-thirds of Republican candidates in competitive US House and Senate races have broken with President Donald Trump on policy or played down ties to him, a Reuters review found, revealing a widespread effort to distance themselves from the president as his unpopularity threatens the party's hold on Congress.
The review of voting records, public statements and campaign materials found candidates in 41 of 62 competitive congressional races seeking some distance from Trump ahead of the November 3 midterm elections .
The candidates have largely criticized or diverged from Trump on individual issues rather than repudiated his broader agenda. The findings suggest an effort to attract independent voters while avoiding a direct break with their party leader.
Policy differences were the most common point of divergence, appearing in 23 of the 62 races.
In 12 contests, the split centered on the Iran conflict, with vulnerable Republicans either voting to curb Trump's war powers or calling publicly for an end to the fighting that has raised gas prices and squeezed household budgets.
Data centers are among the issues dividing Trump and some Republican candidates. Reuters identified three candidates in competitive races who have criticized or sought to slow such projects despite the president's support for faster development.
The shift is notable because Trump has spent the past decade remaking the Republican Party in his own image and has been swift to punish lawmakers and candidates who defied him through primary challenges, personal attacks or public pressure to fall into line.
In response to questions about the Reuters findings, White House spokesman Davis Ingle pointed to the administration's accomplishments and said Trump was "the unequivocal leader, best messenger and unmatched motivator" for the party.
While news organizations have highlighted individual cases of distancing, the Reuters review is the first to systematically measure the trend across competitive races that will decide whether Republicans retain control of either or both chambers of Congress.
A new [USN:L6N45R10Y TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos poll"] underscored the challenge facing Republicans: Trump's approval rating remained stuck at a career-low 32%, while registered voters favored Democrats over Republicans 44% to 37% ahead of the midterms. Among independents, Democrats led 37% to 21%.
CREATING DISTANCE FROM TRUMP Reuters also found a broad effort to play down ties: A dozen candidates removed his name, image or endorsements from campaign websites, most after securing their party's nomination.
Others acted in subtler ways, skipping his events or declining to say whether he should campaign on their behalf.
Direct criticism was relatively rare, underscoring Trump's dominance of the Republican Party and the risks candidates face in openly challenging a president who still commands the loyalty of many ardent supporters.
Candidates distancing themselves from an unpopular president before an election is not unusual. Democrats employed similar tactics in the 2014 and 2022 elections.
While Reuters did not conduct a comparable review of competitive races in the 2018 midterms during Trump's first term, analysts said Trump has rarely faced such widespread pushback by vulnerable Republican candidates.
"(Candidates) are reflecting voter attitudes in these races," said Republican strategist Ron Bonjean. "If (voters) are not with Trump, then they need to show a break."
Privately, campaign advisers told Reuters that candidates needed to dial back ties to Trump to attract independent voters. Publicly, they dismissed criticism of the repositioning.
BALANCING ACT Republican Senator Pete Ricketts, who faces a tough challenge from independent Dan Osborn in Nebraska, exemplifies the 11 candidates identified by Reuters who broke with Trump on one policy issue while backing him on everything else.
The balancing act was on display this week when Ricketts, who criticized Trump's plan to expand beef imports, joined the president at a Nebraska rally.
"President Trump, I have been fighting for you in Washington," Ricketts told the crowd.
Mariannette Miller-Meeks, a Republican in one of the country's most competitive House races in Iowa, has also shown a growing willingness to break with the administration. She was among 12 candidates identified by Reuters who split with Trump on multiple issues, criticizing his beef-import policy and later voting to limit his war powers in Iran after previously opposing similar measures.
Yet, less than two weeks after her war-powers vote, Miller-Meeks joined Trump at the White House to announce a major steel plant investment in Iowa.
"It is a balancing act," said Republican consultant Jeanette Hoffman, adding that candidates are trying to capitalize on the administration’s successes while creating some distance from Trump because of “how toxic the Trump brand is at the moment.”
SCRUBBING TRUMP REFERENCES As Republicans in competitive races seek to expand their appeal beyond Trump's core supporters, some candidates have begun dialing back public displays of loyalty to the president.
Mike Beltran, a former Florida state representative running against Democratic US Representative Kathy Castor, is among candidates who have scrubbed prominent references to Trump from their campaign websites.
In August, his homepage featured a photo of Trump and said he stood with the president, according to the Wayback Machine, an internet archive website. Now Beltran's homepage shows only him and his family and makes no mention of Trump.
Beltran's campaign had no immediate response to a Reuters request for comment.
Representative Mike Lawler of New York, facing one of the most competitive US House races, embodies the balancing act confronting many Republicans in battleground districts: staying close to Trump while demonstrating independence from him.
Lawler has highlighted breaks with Trump on issues including temporary legal protections for Haitian immigrants and a Trump-backed proposal to restore Turkey's access to F-35 fighter jets.
His campaign manager Ciro Riccardi said Lawler acts on behalf of his constituency regardless of a president's stance.
Lawler acknowledged the disagreements in a speech to Trump supporters at the Republican midterm convention in September, saying, "The truth is that the president and I don't always agree. And that's OK."

items.title: US consumer watchdog examiners adopt lighter touch amid pressure and threats, sources say
items.author: Douglas Gillison
items.creator: Douglas Gillison
items.summary: Examiners at the US Consumer Financial Protection Bureau gave a largely clean bill of health to most of the companies they inspected earlier this year, a light-touch approach that marked a departure from the past for the watchdog, according to three people with knowledge of the matter.
items.body:
Examiners at the US Consumer Financial Protection Bureau gave a largely clean bill of health to most of the companies they inspected earlier this year, a light-touch approach that marked a departure from the past for the watchdog, according to three people with knowledge of the matter.
The CFPB resumed examinations in the spring after President Donald Trump's administration had suspended most of the agency's work upon taking office last year.
More than half of those exams went through an "expedited review," which means supervisors identified at most only minor lapses with little risk of harm to consumers, making penalties unlikely, the people said.
Such reviews are more lenient and were historically rare, said the people. But the agency's new political leadership had made it clear via policy changes and other communications that thorough scrutiny was unwelcome and that examiners' jobs were at risk, they added.
The high proportion of expedited reviews, which Reuters is reporting for the first time, could expose consumers to harm if the agency overlooked or minimized serious problems, supervisory experts and former agency officials said.
It also shows how the administration's effort [USN:S0N3VI038 TEXT:"to cut federal workers"], narrow exams, and encourage companies to report officials they feel are too tough on them is reshaping frontline oversight of the financial industry, they added.
Representatives for the CFPB did not respond to requests for comment. The White House referred Reuters to the CFPB.
SHIFT IN AGENCY FOCUS The Trump administration says financial industry oversight has become too onerous, hurting lending and the broader economy, though consumer advocates dispute that. It has also said it is trying to focus examiners on core risks.
Russell Vought, the CFPB's former acting director, has accused the agency's staff of "thuggery" in their dealings with firms. He told lawmakers in July that it has shifted its supervisory approach with the aim of doing "as little damage as possible," adding: "That doesn't mean we're taking an approach to do... as little as possible."
After initially vowing to [USN:S0N3TX02A TEXT:"abolish the CFPB"] — which Congress created in the wake of the 2007-2009 global financial crisis — the administration tried [USN:L6N40K10U TEXT:"to slash two thirds of its workforce"], including the vast majority of supervisory staff.
Those plans [USN:L6N43C0UH TEXT:"are now on pause"] pending confirmation of a new CFPB director.
The agency last year said it would cut the number of exams by half and refocus them away from what had been core areas, such as student loans and medical debt, and more toward mortgages and redress for military service members. It also said it would mostly focus exams on banks rather than nonbanks, such as payday lenders, which the CFPB alone oversees at the federal level.
The agency also now requires examiners to recite [USN:L6N3WX14P TEXT:"a "humility pledge""] during exams to work efficiently, transparently and collaboratively with the company concerned. [USN:L6N43U16E TEXT:"Reuters reported in August"] that a top CFPB examiner reminded staff of that pledge and warned of "most unpleasant" consequences if they were too aggressive.
Larry Lee, a former CFPB attorney who left the agency in August, said examiners have no incentive to look diligently for violations in the current climate, even as companies benefit long term from robust oversight.
"Today's undiscovered compliance issues may fester and explode into tomorrow's widespread but preventable consumer injuries," said Lee, who now leads consumer financial protection policy at nonprofit Better Markets.
EXAMS HELP CATCH PROBLEMS IN REAL TIME Under the rules, CFPB officials select for examination companies they believe pose the highest risks to consumers, usually after months of analysis.
This year, roughly 70 companies were selected, about half the usual number, with examinations scheduled roughly evenly across four quarters, according to the people and a fourth person with knowledge of the matter. Reuters could not ascertain exactly how many firms were examined in the spring.
Examiners typically inspect records and talk with company employees to uncover any compliance or regulatory violations before deciding how to proceed. In the past, most exams moved to a "full review," involving legal analysis of violations and internal discussions on whether the issue merits enforcement action.
However, this spring examiners in most cases determined the inspections were "clean" under agency guidelines and proceeded with expedited reviews, the three people said. That means they determined that any violations were minor and unlikely to harm consumers, and it was therefore unnecessary to escalate them to legal or enforcement teams, according to public CFPB materials.
Austin Hinkle, former senior counsel in the CFPB's Supervision Division, said that expedited reviews were traditionally rare because the process was designed to focus on the riskiest companies.
"A significant number of expedited track reviews suggest to me that either political leadership simply picked the wrong companies to examine, or that when violations are identified, career staff are being told to back off," he said.
Examinations are meant in part to correct problems as they are happening. In the past, examiners have identified and swiftly remedied improper vehicle repossessions, harassing or abusive phone calls, attempts to collect money that borrowers do not owe, overcharges and unjustified fees, according to CFPB materials.
Lorelei Salas, who [USN:L1N3P20QG TEXT:"resigned last year"] as the CFPB's director of supervision after the agency halted the division's work, said she felt the CFPB leadership had demonized supervisory staff.
She added that by no longer focusing on nonbanks, it was ignoring "companies that pose the highest risks to consumers" at a time when many are struggling.
"The picture is pretty grim for consumers in the United States," she said.

WASHINGTON, Oct 7 : Most US voters think President Donald Trump's administration and Congress are not taking the risks of AI seriously enough and want the government to write new regulations for the technology, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos poll.
The six-day survey, which ended on Monday, showed that wide swaths of the electorate see AI as a major threat to American jobs, underscoring growing skepticism of the technology from voters across the political spectrum.
The fast-advancing technology has become a matter of keen national interest amid reports of AI agents running amok and hacking into corporate computer networks, and warnings from prominent researchers that it could one day pose an existential threat to humanity. Noisy, power-hungry data centers that power AI also increasingly pose a nuisance when they pop up near neighborhoods while jacking up utility bills.
Some 57 per cent of registered voters in the poll — including a third of self-identified Republicans — said the Trump administration has not taken AI risks seriously enough or at all. Some 54 per cent said the same about Congress.

Artificial intelligence has become a significant campaign issue ahead of the November 3 midterm elections when control of Congress is up for grabs. Some 62 per cent of voters in the poll said the technology could get out of control and risk the future of humankind, roughly the same share of voters with that view in a Reuters/Ipsos poll from August of last year. 
Trump has repeatedly voiced unhesitating support for AI and the construction of data centers, arguing they are vital to US competitiveness even as bipartisan criticism of the technology grows. He often says the US tech industry will fall behind its Chinese counterparts when asked why his government hasn't set limits on the technology's use and development, a point that AI safety advocates say is misguided. 
"That's an important concern but it's not top of mind for most Americans, nor should it be," said Daniel Kokotajlo, a former OpenAI staffer who quit in 2024 because he believed the company wasn't behaving responsibly.
The more pressing concern is that AI could cost people their jobs or threaten human health and safety, he said.
In a statement to Reuters about the president's handling of AI, a White House official pointed to Trump's new task force, which he said is in charge of ensuring that "America continues to lead the world" on the technology.
"The Trump administration’s priority is to ensure there is a booming economy so that workers have many opportunities and experience limited volatility from any short-term disruptions," the official said when asked about voters' AI-related employment fears.
LITTLE FEDERAL ACTION
While high-profile leaders ranging from US Senator Bernie Sanders — a democratic socialist who caucuses with Democrats — to Steve Bannon — a hard right ally of President Donald Trump — have called for federal action, little has come so far.
Trump last week said executives from the six leading AI developers agreed to a set of voluntary safety principles, including working with "independent auditors" to assess whether AI systems are working as their designers intended.
The safety agreement with the companies — Nvidia, SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Alphabet’s Google — includes no stated consequences if a company chooses not to comply. Congress has so far failed to agree on legislation that would set guardrails on the technology, and lawmakers are expected to be away from Washington until after the midterms. 
The new Reuters/Ipsos poll found 84 per cent of voters saw AI as a threat to American workers. By comparison, only 60 per cent saw illegal immigration as a threat to American workers, while 74 per cent viewed competition from foreign workers that way and 73 per cent said the same of large corporations.
A bipartisan majority of voters - including 80 per cent of Democrats and 61 per cent of Republicans - said they supported stricter government regulation on AI.
Many voters also oppose building the data centers that power AI, which has become a pressing issue in congressional and statewide races across the country as candidates from both parties urge a pause in the current construction boom.
Fifty-six percent of voters in the Reuters/Ipsos poll back limits on building data centers, including 69 per cent of Democrats, 55 per cent of independents and 43 per cent of Republicans. 
The poll also found growing unease with the ways that AI could be used in warfare. Some 57 per cent of voters think the US government should not use AI to determine the target of a military strike, up from 49 per cent in a Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted in August 2025.
The Reuters/Ipsos poll, which was conducted online and nationwide, gathered responses from 4,506 US adults, including 3,526 registered voters. The survey has a margin of error of 2 per centage points.

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] - ロックフェラー財団などの専門家らは７日、多額の債務を抱える開発途上国が経済成長を図り、必要な投資を行い、民間資本を活用できるよう、新たな資金へのアクセスを支援するイニシアチブ「成長・投資リセット」を提案した。

国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）、世界銀行、２国間公的債権者、民間貸し手らの取り組みを調整することで、低所得国が深刻な債務危機に陥るのを防ぐことを目的としているという。

必要な政治的合意を確保し、英国が議長国を務める来年の主要２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０） の下で取り組みを前進させることを目指す。論文執筆者らは「開発途上国は不可欠な投資を圧迫する前例のない利払い負担に苦しんでいる。緊急の対策が講じられなければ、状況はさらに悪化するだろう」と述べた。

執筆者の１人によると、開発途上国における利払い額は平均して歳入の１０％を超えており、１０カ国ではその額が公共投資を上回っている。債務水準が持続可能な約４０カ国がこのイニシアチブの適用対象となるが、一部の国では依然として債務再編が必要になるという。

今回の提案は来週バンコクで開催されるＩＭＦ・世界銀行年次総会を控えて行われた。

STOCKHOLM, Oct 7 (Reuters) – Scientists Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry “for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis,” the award-giving body said on Wednesday.

The chemistry Nobel, always the third prize to be awarded during Nobel week, followed those for medicine and physics announced on Monday and Tuesday.

“So this year’s prize is about foundational chemistry. Many molecules occur in two different versions. Like my hands. They are one another’s mirror image, they look alike, but they are not identical. I cannot put my hands on top of one another. Such molecules are called chiral, from the Greek word for hand, Heiner Linke, Chair of the Nobel Committee for Chemistry, said.

Show Full Article

Established in the will of Swedish inventor and businessman Alfred Nobel, the prizes for achievements in science, literature and peace have been awarded since 1901, with a few interruptions mostly due to the world wars.

Nobel, a chemist by trade, amassed huge wealth in the 19th century from inventions primarily tied to warfare, most notably dynamite. The economics prize is a later addition funded by the Swedish central bank.

Sometimes overshadowed by more famous laureates in the fields of physics, literature and peace, the chemistry awards have still recognised many influential discoveries such as nuclear fission and genetic sequencing techniques.

Last year’s chemistry award went to scientists Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi for the development of so-called metal–organic frameworks, molecular constructions that can help tackle challenges such as climate change and lack of fresh water.

The laureates will receive their medals from Sweden’s King Carl XVI Gustaf at a ceremony in Stockholm on December 10, the anniversary of Alfred Nobel’s death. The awards are followed by a lavish banquet at Stockholm City Hall.

They also share 12 million Swedish crowns ($1.2 million), as well as the fame of winning arguably the world’s most prestigious science award.

The peace prize, the only Nobel not presented in Sweden, is awarded separately in Oslo.

($1 = 10.0309 Swedish crowns)

items.title: Porsche apuesta por vender menos y más caro con un nuevo modelo por encima del 911
items.author: William Wilkes
items.summary: Porsche busca recuperar su rentabilidad con una estrategia de mayor exclusividad, que contempla subir 20% los precios de sus deportivos y ampliar su gama con un modelo por encima del 911.
items.body: Bloomberg — Porsche AG tiene previsto aumentar los precios de sus coches deportivos de gama alta en un promedio del 20%, lo que incluye la introducción de un nuevo modelo que se situará por encima del 911, su buque insignia desde hace mucho tiempo, en la gama, en un intento por reactivar unos beneficios en declive. El fabricante alemán reveló el miércoles, en una presentación ante inversores, una nueva estrategia centrada en vender menos vehículos, pero de gama más alta y con características especiales, con el fin de impulsar la rentabilidad. Esta apuesta por una mayor exclusividad se produce tras costosos errores en materia de electrificación y una caída de las ventas en China. Ver más: Porsche eleva previsión de margen de flujo de caja tras venta de Bugatti por €1.000 millones El CEO, Michael Leiters, advirtió que la recuperación llevará tiempo y que, por el momento, se está trabajando en la reducción de gastos. A medio plazo, la empresa afirmó que los precios de sus vehículos más exclusivos aumentarán, ya que Porsche se inclina por ofrecer a los compradores materiales a medida y características de rendimiento personalizadas. Se prevé que el precio medio de los modelos de gama alta de Porsche suba a más de 330.000 euros (US$370.134) a finales de la década, frente a los aproximadamente 270.000 euros de este año, según la presentación de la empresa. “La máxima prioridad es seguir reforzando nuestra marca única de coches deportivos en toda la gama, con nuevos y atractivos modelos en segmentos con márgenes especialmente elevados”, afirmó Leiters durante una rueda de prensa celebrada en Stuttgart. Las acciones de Porsche subían un 0,7% a las 9:50 de la mañana en Fráncfort, tras recortar las ganancias anteriores, que llegaron a alcanzar el 5,1%. Las acciones han bajado alrededor de un 6% desde principios de año. Ver más: Este reloj de titanio solo se consigue cuando compras un Porsche 911 GT3 La empresa también detalló sus planes para una gama de vehículos por encima del 911 que devolvería al fabricante al segmento de los superdeportivos por primera vez desde que se presentó el 918 Spyder, de producción limitada, en 2013. Con el objetivo de adoptar una arquitectura de motor central, esta configuración puede mejorar la distribución del peso y la maniobrabilidad. Dicha expansión acercaría a Porsche a la gama de deportivos y gran turismos de Ferrari NV. Porsche también tiene previsto obtener más ingresos de Manthey, el especialista en automovilismo con sede en Nürburgring, aumentando su participación del 51% al 67%. Manthey desarrolla mejoras para circuitos homologadas para la vía pública, entre las que se incluyen suspensiones, frenos, llantas ligeras y componentes aerodinámicos. Una gama más amplia de ofertas conjuntas supondrá una vía adicional para impulsar las ventas a través de productos especiales, en lugar de un mayor volumen. Se supone que esta reestructuración preparará a Porsche para los aranceles permanentes de EE.UU. y para un negocio en China que probablemente no recupere su tamaño anterior. Los cambios en la gama de modelos vendrán precedidos de profundos recortes de costos, incluidos los planes ya acordados para reducir la plantilla en más de una quinta parte y los puestos directivos en un 40%. “En estos momentos, el objetivo principal es reducir costos y dotar a la empresa de una mayor solidez financiera”, afirmó Leiters. Porsche debe, en primer lugar, “poner orden en su propia casa” antes de seguir avanzando hacia el segmento de gama alta, añadió. Ver más: Suzuki desafía a BYD con un mini auto eléctrico de US$10.120 y aviva competencia en Japón Porsche, uno de los principales centros de beneficios de su matriz, Volkswagen AG, aspira a recuperar la capacidad de generación de beneficios que en su día la convirtió en uno de los fabricantes de automóviles más rentables de Europa. La empresa se ha fijado como objetivo alcanzar un margen operativo de entre el 10% y el 15% a medio plazo, con un objetivo a más largo plazo del 15%, después de que los costos de reestructuración, los aranceles y la menor demanda hicieran caer este indicador de rentabilidad hasta apenas el 1,1% el año pasado. Esta caída ha provocado amortizaciones por valor de varios miles de millones de euros en VW y ha reducido los dividendos destinados a Porsche SE, el vehículo de inversión controlado por la familia multimillonaria Porsche-Piëch. Se prevé que la generación de efectivo se recupere de forma notable, y Porsche aspira a alcanzar un margen de flujo de caja neto en el sector automovilístico de hasta el 12%. La empresa ha experimentado una cierta recuperación, con unos márgenes operativos del 7,8% durante el primer semestre de este año. Porsche, que entregó algo menos de 280.000 vehículos el año pasado, también está cerrando y vendiendo negocios no esenciales, como su participación en una empresa conjunta propietaria del fabricante de supercoches Bugatti. En toda la empresa, los acuerdos alcanzados con los representantes de los trabajadores a principios de este año prevén una reducción de la plantilla en 9.000 puestos de trabajo. Ver más: Renault y Geely refuerzan su inversión en Brasil con US$388 millones: apuestan por un nuevo auto eléctrico La empresa también se propone reducir su volumen anual de umbral de rentabilidad a unas 200.000 unidades mediante la reducción de costos, incluida una reducción de aproximadamente el 20% en los gastos de desarrollo, según las presentaciones publicadas con antelación a su “Capital Markets Day”. Leiters se negó a revelar el umbral de rentabilidad actual, pero señaló que la empresa está preparada para aumentar la producción, con un pico de producción de aproximadamente 330.000 vehículos en 2023. VW también está reduciendo su presencia industrial con un plan para recortar 100.000 puestos de trabajo, principalmente en Alemania, mientras que Mercedes-Benz Group AG y BMW AG están reajustando sus objetivos de beneficios. Con la colaboración de Iain Rogers. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Inflación de Colombia en septiembre: mercado prevé que siga por encima del 6,2%
items.author: María C. Suárez
items.summary: Las proyecciones de los analistas coinciden en que los precios no dan tregua, aunque difieren en cuánto pesará la canasta de alimentos, golpeada por el Fenómeno de El Niño y una menor oferta agrícola.
items.body: Bogotá — Este miércoles 7 de octubre el DANE publicará el Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) de septiembre. Las proyecciones de los analistas coinciden en que los precios no dan tregua, aunque difieren en cuánto pesará la canasta de alimentos, golpeada por el Fenómeno de El Niño y por una menor oferta agrícola. “Proyectamos una inflación mensual de 0,32% en septiembre, que mantendría la inflación anual prácticamente estable en 6,25%”, señaló Corficolombiana ( Grupo Aval ) en su más reciente informe del IPC. En agosto, la inflación subió 0,39% mensual, un registro que, según la firma, quedó por encima de su expectativa (0,32%) y la del consenso de analistas (0,27%). Con ese dato, la inflación anual pasó de 6,03% a 6,24%, alcanzando su nivel más alto desde julio de 2024. Para septiembre, Corficolombiana espera que el resultado esté “explicado principalmente por alimentos y servicios, parcialmente compensados por la moderación de la inflación de energéticos dentro de los regulados”. Ver más: Importadores de llantas chinas en Colombia se defienden en investigación dumping que arrancó Goodyear En alimentos proyecta una variación mensual de 0,41%, con lo que la inflación anual se aceleraría de 6,10% a 6,34%. El alza vendría de los perecederos, particularmente frutas frescas, hortalizas y plátanos, en un contexto de menor abastecimiento agrícola. En servicios, la entidad estima una variación de 0,32%, impulsada principalmente por arriendos, comidas fuera del hogar y servicios de educación, lo que llevaría la inflación anual de este grupo de 7,17% a 7,12%. Los regulados, en cambio, darían un respiro: su inflación anual bajaría de 6,77% a 6,61%, interrumpiendo la tendencia de siete meses consecutivos acelerándose, gracias a menores tarifas de electricidad y gas. En bienes, la variación anual subiría levemente, de 3,29% a 3,33%. El Grupo Cibest , en su más reciente monitor de precios de alimentos, plantea un escenario más presionado para la canasta de comida. “Nuestras estimaciones apuntan a una inflación mensual de alimentos en septiembre de 0,97%, equivalente en términos anuales a 6,97%”. Esa cifra es más del doble del 0,41 % que proyectó Corficolombiana a mediados de septiembre. Según Cibest, los perecederos “continuarían acelerándose”, con una variación mensual de 2,7% y una anual de 13,64%. Los mayores aumentos estarían en las papas (13%), la arracacha y el ñame (11,3%), las moras (9,3%) y las frutas frescas (2,9%). La entidad atribuye estos resultados a “las presiones ejercidas por las altas temperaturas y la estacionalidad de las cosechas”. Ver más: Del Movistar Arena a Juan Valdez: quién es el nuevo gerente que dirigirá el negocio de la marca En las proteínas el panorama es más mixto. De acuerdo con el reporte, “los incrementos mensuales más relevantes se dieron en la carne de res (0,7%) y de aves (0,3%)”, mientras que la carne de cerdo cayó 0,5%. Los procesados subirían 0,45% en el mes. Si se confirma el cálculo de Cibest, el aporte de los alimentos al IPC total sería mayor al previsto, lo que podría llevar el dato general por encima del 0,32% estimado por Corficolombiana. El Niño y la política monetaria Detrás de las presiones está el clima. Corficolombiana advierte que el país acumula cuatro meses bajo El Niño, “cuya intensidad se encuentra entre las más elevadas de las últimas tres décadas”. Según datos de la NOAA, la probabilidad de un “Súper Niño” en el último trimestre del año supera el 90%. Sus efectos llegarían por la vía de la energía, por la mayor dependencia de la generación térmica, “más costosa, presionando las tarifas”, y de los alimentos. Ver más: Las 15 acciones más valiosas del mercado regional: ¿Cuáles comprar en Nuam? A esto se suma que la inflación básica sigue alta. La firma calcula que la inflación sin alimentos ni regulados se mantendría en 6,12%, lo que sugiere que “las presiones inflacionarias subyacentes permanecen elevadas”. Por eso, Corficolombiana mantiene su proyección de 6,8% para el cierre de 2026 y, en su informe de septiembre, considera “necesario un mayor endurecimiento monetario para contener los efectos de segunda ronda” y asegurar que la inflación empiece a converger hacia la meta a partir de 2027.

items.creator: ロイター

[７日 ロイター] - ドイツの高級車メーカー、メルセデス・ベンツは７日、中国市場の厳しい状況により、主力事業である乗用車部門の第３・四半期の販売台数が前年同期比８％減となり、減少傾向が続いたと発表した。

• 第３・四半期の自動車販売台数は４０万７２００台。

• 中国市場では、前年同期比３１％減の８万６８００台となった。

• ハイエンドセグメントの販売台数は、中国における市場環境の悪化や継続中のモデルチェンジの影響を受け、２１％減の５万３９００台となった。

• 一方、米国では乗用車販売台数が６％増、欧州では５％増となった。

•

items.title: Nobel chemistry prize goes to pair who solved mystery of 'mirror image' molecules
items.author: Marie Mannes, Simon Johnson, Johan Ahlander
items.creator: Marie Mannes, Simon Johnson, Johan Ahlander
items.summary: Scientists Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for solving a long-standing riddle of asymmetric "mirror image" molecules, a discovery hugely important for pharmaceutical manufacturing.
items.body:
Scientists Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for solving a long-standing riddle of asymmetric "mirror image" molecules, a discovery hugely important for pharmaceutical manufacturing, the award-giving body said on Wednesday.
Soai, 76, is Japanese, and Kagan, 95, is French, and their work built on a discovery by the 19th-century French chemist Louis Pasteur.
"This is the most exciting day in my life, I am very glad to share this prize with professor Henri Kagan," Soai said, speaking by phone to the Nobel Prize press conference, adding he had been out shopping when receiving the news.
The Nobel committee was still trying to contact Kagan, the third-oldest person to be awarded a Nobel Prize, to inform him.
French President Emmanuel Macron congratulated the laureates on X, calling it an immense honour for the country. "A recognition suited to a lifetime of research," he said.
In fact, Kagan's work has long been seen as influential on the field and the then-French research minister complained to the Nobel Foundation in 2001 when Kagan was left out that year. The prize instead went to two American and one Japanese scientists for work in the same field.
The chemistry Nobel, always the third prize to be awarded during Nobel week, followed those for [USN:L1N45R0AK TEXT:"medicine"] and [USN:L1N45S0E6 TEXT:"physics"] announced on Monday and Tuesday.
'RIGHT-HANDED' AND 'LEFT-HANDED' MOLECULES Many of the molecules essential to life exist in two forms that are mirror images of each other, like left and right hands. Yet living organisms almost exclusively use only one version, a phenomenon known as "homochirality" – from the Greek word for hand – that has puzzled chemists for more than a century.
This year's prize was awarded for discoveries that showed how chemical reactions can be driven to favour a single molecular mirror image, work that has been key for chemists who design reactions for the manufacture of pharmaceuticals.
"The left-handed version of the drug can have one effect, and the right-handed version can have another effect, and then we need methods for selectively preparing them," Peter Somfai, a member of the Nobel Committee for Chemistry, said.
"In developing such methods the findings of this year's laureates are important. They provided powerful tools for that," he said.
BUILDING ON WORK BY LOUIS PASTEUR The first link in the chain in solving the problem was work by Pasteur, who died a few years before the Nobel Prizes [USN:L1N45N0AY TEXT:"were first awarded in 1901"].
He was looking at tartaric acid, important in the production of wine, and noticed that bacteria only ferment one of the two forms of tartaric acid – that which is naturally found in grapes. With the other there is no fermentation.
That proved that some substances occur in two forms and that they have different properties, sometimes very damaging to health.
How to create the right form of a chiral substance was a problem not solved until Kagan and Soai were able to produce asymmetric reactions, creating an excess of one form.
The importance of the work is illustrated by the case of the thalidomide scandal in the early 1960s, when thousands of children were affected by birth defects caused by a sedative, thalidomide.
When researchers analysed what had happened, they realised that it was the active substance's mirror image that caused the harm.
PRIZES ESTABLISHED IN WILL OF SWEDISH INVENTOR Established in the will of Swedish inventor and businessman Alfred Nobel, the prizes for achievements in science, literature and peace have been awarded since 1901, with a few interruptions mostly due to the world wars.
Nobel, a chemist by trade, amassed huge wealth in the 19th century from inventions primarily tied to warfare, most notably dynamite. The economics prize is a later addition funded by the Swedish central bank.
Sometimes overshadowed by more famous laureates in the fields of physics, literature and peace, the chemistry awards have still recognised many influential discoveries such as nuclear fission and genetic sequencing techniques.
Last year's chemistry award went to scientists [USN:L2N3VP07T TEXT:"Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi"] for the development of so-called metal–organic frameworks, molecular constructions that can help tackle challenges such as climate change and lack of fresh water.
The laureates will receive their medals from Sweden's King Carl XVI Gustaf at a ceremony in Stockholm on December 10, the anniversary of Alfred Nobel's death. The awards are followed by a lavish banquet at Stockholm City Hall.
They also share 12 million Swedish crowns ($1.2 million), as well as the fame of winning arguably the world's most prestigious science award.
The [USN:L6N44L0GC TEXT:"peace prize"], the only Nobel not presented in Sweden, is awarded separately in Oslo.
($1 = 10.0309 Swedish crowns)

BERLIN, Oct 7 : Tesla CEO Elon Musk on Wednesday welcomed Germany's backing for the US automaker's driver-assistance software system, as he seeks Europe-wide approval for the technology that traffic-safety researchers have warned carries inflated safety claims.
"Danke schoen," wrote Musk on his social media platform X about German Transport Minister Steffen Bilger pushing for approval of the "Full Self-Driving" technology across Europe.
Bilger said in a statement on Tuesday that he is advocating for prompt EU approval after discussing numerous technical details, as well as liability issues, with Tesla last month.
As part of the discussions, Germany agreed with Tesla that the system may slightly exceed the maximum speed limit by up to 10 per cent – an approach Germany will also support within the European approval process, where speeding has become one of the main points of contention.

Safety advocates and some regulators argue Tesla's use of a speed-offset function, which allows the system to drive above the posted limit, should be removed before approval is granted.
Bilger added that Tesla has also offered to rename the system "Tesla Assisted Driving" to address concerns that the name is somewhat misleading. The system offers assistance to drivers, but is not fully autonomous.
"My goal is for Tesla drivers to be able to enjoy the benefits of 'assisted driving' throughout the EU without delay," said Bilger.
TESLA LOBBYING HARD FOR EU APPROVAL
Germany is the latest in a handful of European countries, including the Netherlands and Belgium, to throw their support behind the technology.
However, several EU countries, including Sweden and France, have expressed concerns about FSD exceeding speed limits, and an EU vote expected for October has been pushed back to at least December while some countries do additional tests.
The Europe-specific version of the system approved by Dutch regulators earlier this year excluded some features available in the US, including a so-called 'Mad Max' setting, but retained a function that can lift the vehicle's maximum speed to as much as 50 per cent above the detected speed limit.
Tesla, whose first European factory was built outside Berlin, has called FSD approval key to boosting sales in Europe, where it is seeking to regain market share amid growing competition from Chinese electric-vehicle makers.
A Reuters Special Report on Wednesday detailed how Tesla has mounted an intensive lobbying campaign to secure European approval for the system, and has won support from some national regulators despite ongoing concerns from safety experts and several EU member states.
The company casts FSD as a life-saving technology, though experts who examined Tesla's methodology for Reuters say the company's study provides no evidence of that claim, which is central to Tesla's current European lobbying campaign.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Mayor of Turkey's secular stronghold Izmir joins Erdogan's party
items.author: Ece Toksabay, Huseyin Hayatsever
items.creator: Ece Toksabay, Huseyin Hayatsever
items.summary: The mayor of Izmir, Turkey's third-largest city and a bastion of its secular opposition, joined President Tayyip Erdogan's ruling AK Party (AKP) on Wednesday, amid a crackdown on the opposition in which dozens of mayors have been jailed.
items.body:
The mayor of Izmir, Turkey's third-largest city and a bastion of its secular opposition, joined President Tayyip Erdogan's ruling AK Party (AKP) on Wednesday, amid a crackdown on the opposition in which dozens of mayors have been jailed.
Cemil Tugay, elected mayor in 2024 as a candidate of the opposition Republican People's Party (CHP) before quitting in June, formally joined the AKP at a ceremony in Ankara, handing Erdogan's party the mayoralty of a city it has never managed to win at the ballot box.
"I have no doubt that, with harmony between the local administration and central government, we will achieve great things," Tugay said.
The move is a significant symbolic gain for Erdogan's party in the western coastal city, long regarded as the heartland of Turkey's secular, social democratic opposition.
The religiously and socially conservative AKP, founded by Erdogan in 2001, has never won the Izmir metropolitan municipality despite dominating national politics for more than two decades.
Tugay won the March 2024 election with 49% of the vote, against 37% for the AKP candidate. The CHP also won 28 of Izmir's 30 district municipalities.
MANY MAYORS ARE IN JAIL AWAITING TRIAL Erdogan's AKP suffered a major electoral blow in the March 2024 mayoral elections but since then Turkish authorities have launched an unprecedented crackdown on opposition municipalities that saw many mayors targeted with corruption charges that critics say are unfounded.
Dozens of mayors, including Istanbul's Mayor Ekrem Imamoglu, who is seen as Erdogan's main rival, are in jail pending trial. Tunc Soyer, who was the Izmir mayor before Tugay, is also among those jailed as part of a corruption probe.
The opposition has rejected the corruption accusations and says the investigations are politically motivated. The government says the judiciary is independent.
Tugay resigned from the CHP in June after a [USN:L6N41Y0ZX TEXT:"court ruling"] that annulled the CHP 2023 congress and stripped Ozgur Ozel of his title as CHP chairman. However, he did not join [USN:L6N43Q11G TEXT:"the New Party"] founded by Ozel and 90 opposition MPs in protest over the court ruling and continued as an independent mayor.
Ozel accused the AKP on Tuesday of using blackmail and the threat of imprisonment to pressure Tugay into defecting.
"Those who refuse to bow to this pressure ... and do not betray their friends or their party will remain our brothers until the day we die. Those who sell out and leave are genuine traitors," Ozel told his party's parliamentary group.
Erdogan rejected such accusations at Wednesday's ceremony.
"Those who want to serve their cities in peace see the AK Party as the safest address," Erdogan said.
"This is the reason for the growing support for the AK Party. Any suggestion otherwise is slander and speculation."
Tugay is the second mayor of a large city to defect to the AKP from the CHP, after [USN:L8N3U60RK TEXT:"Ozlem Cercioglu"], mayor of Aydin, another western coastal city. [USN:L1N43N0LL TEXT:"Dozens of district mayors"] elected from opposition parties in 2024 have also joined the AKP since then.

items.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝香港下落、ＡＩ・バイオテク株に売り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［香港　７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［香港　７日　ロイター］ - 香港株式市場は下落した。アジア市場全般の軟調な地合いを受けた流れで、原油価格が上昇する中、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株とバイオテクノロジー株が下げを主導した。

ハンセン指数は０．６％安、ハンセン中国株指数も０．６％安で引けた。

ハンセンテック指数は０．７％下げた。

テンプルトン・グローバル・インベストメンツのリサーチ責任者、バッセル・カトゥン氏はリポートで「政策支援にもかかわらず中国市場は低調にとどまった。消費需要の弱さと製造業指標のまちまちな結果が、テクノロジー分野への選別的な関心を打ち消した」と述べた。

この日は香港上場の中国ＡＩ・テック企業が売り圧力にさらされた。

ＡＩ開発企業のミニマックスが４％下落し、半導体メーカーの華虹半導体とテクノロジー大手アリババはそれぞれ３％下げた。

バイオテクノロジー株は前営業日の急伸を受けて２．８％下落した。

景気活動の鈍化を背景に、香港の９月のＳ＆Ｐ購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は０．３ポイント低下して４９．２となり、市場心理の弱さに拍車をかけた。同指数は好不況の分かれ目となる５０を２カ月連続で下回った。

中国本土の金融市場は国慶節（建国記念日）の連休で１０月１日から７日まで休場で、取引は１０月８日に再開する。

景気活動の鈍化を背景に、香港の９月のＳ＆Ｐ購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は０．３ポイント低下して４９．２となり、市場心理の弱さに拍車をかけた。同指数は好不況の分かれ目となる５０を２カ月連続で下回った。

中国本土の金融市場は国慶節（建国記念日）の連休で１０月１日から７日まで休場で、取引は１０月８日に再開する。

items.title: ＷＨＯ、ロシアに詳細な情報提供求める　ペスト研究所職員死亡巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[７日 ロイター] - 世界保健機関（ＷＨＯ）は７日、シベリアのペスト研究所職員が死亡した原因について、ロシアにさらなる情報の提供を要請したと発表し、潜在的な健康リスクを明確に把握するためには透明性が不可欠だと述べた。

テドロス事務局長はＸを通じ、「重度の肺炎の原因、公衆衛生措置のきっかけとなった病原体、および原因不明の肺炎を患った２人目の職員に関するメディア報道を明らかにするため、さらなる情報を要請した」と明らかにした。

一部の西側メディアは具体的に明かされていない「ロシアメディア」を引用し、シベリアで２人目の死者が出ており、その死因はペストだと報道。ロイターはロシアメディアにそのような報道を見いだすことができておらず、シベリアで２人目の死者が出たという証拠も確認できなかった。

ロシア保健当局は、研究所職員が肺炎にかかって死亡したと発表しているが、その原因については公に説明していない。肺炎には、ペストを含め、さまざまな原因が考えられる。

items.title: イラク、通貨ディナールを14.5％切り下げ　石油収入減に対応か
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tala Ramadan　Ahmed Rasheed

[７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Tala Ramadan　Ahmed Rasheed

[７日 ロイター] - イラク内閣は通貨ディナールの新たな為替レート体系を承認した。１ドル＝１５２０ディナールに設定し、従来の公定レートから約１４．５％切り下げた。イラン戦争で石油販売に支障が生じたことへの対応とみられる。

通貨切り下げは６日に採択され、７日に発効した。財務省の買い入れレートは１ドル＝１５００ディナール、銀行とノンバンク金融機関が最終利用者に売却する際のレートは同１５１０ディナールとした。

イラクのアナリスト、モハメド・アルサファル氏は「今回のディナール切り下げは基本的に、イラン戦争と輸出の混乱による石油収入への打撃に対する財政的な対応だ」と述べた。「政府は石油収入１ドル当たりで得られるディナールを増やせる一方、輸入コストが上がり、家計の購買力は低下する」と指摘した。

items.title: 次期ＴＯＰＩＸに35銘柄採用、日本マクドナルドＨＤなど　除外候補は683銘柄
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Hiroko Hamada

［東京　７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Hiroko Hamada

［東京　７日　ロイター］ - 日本取引所グループのＪＰＸ総研は７日、ＴＯＰＩＸ改革の第２段階となる見直しで、新たに３５銘柄を採用すると発表した。既存銘柄のうち、基準未達となった移行措置銘柄は６８３銘柄。次期ＴＯＰＩＸの構成銘柄（２０２８年７月末）は９８６銘柄となる見込み。

新規では、日本マクドナルドホールディングス、フェローテック、ワークマン、タイミー、トライアルホールディングスなどが採用された。プライム市場以外では、スタンダードから２３銘柄、グロースから１２銘柄が選定された。

移行措置銘柄には、パソナグループ、三菱総合研究所、コジマ、学研ホールディングス、ブックオフグループホールディングス、テレビ東京ホールディングスなどが入った。

定期入れ替えはプライム、スタンダード、グロースの全市場を対象に、年間売買代金回転率と浮動株時価総額の累積比率という流動性基準をもとに年１回、１０月末に実施される。継続基準を満たさなかった移行措置銘柄は、四半期ごとに８段階でウエートを低減する。移行措置銘柄の再評価は２０２７年１０月に実施される予定で、２７年１０月時点で継続基準を満たした場合は段階的ウエート低減を停止する。２回目の定期入替は２８年１０月。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ベルリン ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ベルリン ７日 ロイター] - ドイツ卸売・貿易連盟（ＢＧＡ）は７日、２０２６年の輸出伸び率見通しを０．６％から１％に上方修正した。欧州での堅調な需要に支えられて予想外に好調だった上半期を受けた。

ＢＧＡによると、上半期の輸出総額は約８１８０億ユーロ（９１６０億ドル）で前年同期比３．９％増となり、輸入は約７１２０億ユーロで４．７％増加した。

通年の輸入伸び率見通しは３％に据え置いた。

ＢＧＡは「ドイツの対外貿易は安定しつつあるが、好転にはまだ程遠い」と述べ、米国および中国への輸出が低迷していることに言及。サプライチェーン（供給網）と市場の多様化を図るとともに、欧州企業の中国市場へのアクセスを改善するよう求めた。

「リスク軽減はデカップリングを意味してはならず、戦略的自立は自給自足を意味してはならない」と述べた。

items.title: 世界の富裕層、金利上昇が成長の最大リスクと認識＝ドイツ銀調査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[シンガポール ７日 ロイター] - ７日に発表されたドイツ銀行の調査によると、世界の富裕層は金利と利回りの上昇を世界経済の成長に対する最大の脅威と見なしている一方で、その大多数は今後１２カ月間でアジアが最も安定した地政学的地域になると予想している。

詳細は以下の通り。

• 調査はシンガポールで開催された同行の「エマージング・マーケッツ・ファミリーオフィス・フォーラム２０２６」において実施され、約２００のファミリーオフィスや富裕層が参加した。

• 調査対象となったファミリーオフィスのうち、３７％が金利と利回りの上昇を世界経済成長にとって最大のリスクと回答し、次いでインフレが２３％、ＡＩ（人工知能）関連リスクが１７％と続いた。

• 回答者の７３％が、今後１２カ月間で最も安定した地政学的地域としてアジアを挙げ、次いで米国が１４％、英国および欧州が６％、ラテンアメリカが４％、中東が２％となった。

• 同行は「国際的な富裕層とそのファミリーオフィスは、安定性、リスク軽減戦略、そしてグローバルなつながりを求めており、この変化する世界において、シンガポールはグローバルなウェルスセンターとして、明らかに有力な選択肢の一つとなっている」と述べた。

items.title: Russia says plague institute worker's death does not risk an epidemic
items.author: Andrew Osborn, Jennifer Rigby
items.creator: Andrew Osborn, Jennifer Rigby
items.summary: Russia's health regulator said on Wednesday there were no risks of an epidemic breaking out in Siberia after a plague institute worker there died, as the World Health Organization pressed Moscow for more information about her cause of death.
items.body:
Russia's health regulator said on Wednesday there were no risks of an epidemic breaking out in Siberia after a [USN:L1N45S0CY TEXT:"plague institute worker"] there died, as the World Health Organization pressed Moscow for more information about her cause of death.
Russian authorities say [USN:L1N45R0VI TEXT:"the 28-year-old laboratory worker"] died on Friday from pneumonia of an as-yet unestablished origin, in [USN:L1N45S0CY TEXT:"a case that has prompted international concern"], including from US President Donald Trump. Around 200 people were initially placed in quarantine.
Global health officials - as well as the world's media - have been particularly alert to pneumonia cases of undetermined cause since the COVID-19 pandemic, which began with a cluster of fast-spreading fatal respiratory illness in China.
However, the cause of individual pneumonia cases can often not be determined. The WHO estimates the risk of the Russia incident to the general public to be low based on currently available information.
Rospotrebnadzor, Russia's health watchdog, said in a statement on Wednesday it was winding down precautionary measures it had put in place after concluding there was no risk of an epidemic and that it had shared its latest information with the WHO.
[USN:L8N45S0R0 TEXT:"No cases of plague had been detected"] among anyone who had come into contact with the deceased worker, Darya Shipilova, it said, and 90% of those placed in quarantine had been released after nearly 5,000 lab tests had failed to detect any dangerous pathogens.
It said Shipilova had been vaccinated and had therefore been "immune to the dangerous infections with which she worked". It did not say though what had caused the pneumonia which killed her or how she fell ill.
WHO CALLS FOR MORE INFORMATION Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, the director-general of the WHO in Geneva, said earlier on Wednesday that his organisation needed more information from Russia to understand what had happened.
"WHO has requested further information to clarify the cause of the severe pneumonia, the pathogen that prompted the public health measures, and media reports of a second employee with pneumonia of undetermined cause," he said on X.
"Timely, complete and transparent information sharing under the International Health Regulations is essential to clarify conflicting reports and enable an accurate assessment of potential public health risks."
KREMLIN CRITICISES 'FALSE INFORMATION' IN MEDIA The Kremlin said Russia had properly informed the WHO about the incident in line with established procedures.
When asked about the WHO's request to respond to reports about a second person in Siberia allegedly falling ill, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov urged caution when it came to using media reports as a reference for what was happening.
"There is a great deal of media coverage, and the vast majority of what the media are reporting about this situation is false information," said Peskov.
He advised the media and others to rely on information provided by the health regulator. It did not immediately respond to a Reuters comment request on Wednesday about the WHO's questions.
EXACT CAUSE OF DEATH REMAINS UNKNOWN Some Western media outlets have reported — citing unnamed "Russian media" — that a second person in Siberia had died, saying they had died of plague.
Reuters was unable to find any such stories in Russian media or any evidence that a second person in Siberia had died although some bloggers on social media were making — without evidence — such assertions.
Contacted by Reuters, the WHO said it had nothing further to add on the matter beyond what Tedros — who was due to give a press conference later on Wednesday — had already posted on X.
Tedros' call for more information echoed that of US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who has also said Moscow needs to share more information about the incident.
Pneumonia, a lung infection, can have a variety of causes including plague as well as other bacterial infections or viral respiratory diseases, such as flu or COVID-19.

items.title: 韓国の教会にＡＩ使ったサイバー攻撃か、数十万人の信徒情報流出の恐れ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ７日 ロイター] - 韓国ソウルにある二つの教会が、サイバー攻撃で数十万人の信徒の個人情報が流出した可能性について調査を進めている。教会側やサイバーセキュリティー企業によると、攻撃には人工知能（ＡＩ）ツールが使用された可能性を示す証拠があるという。

サイバーセキュリティー企業のオアシス・セキュリティーは、ソウルにある汝矣島（ヨイド）純福音教会およびサラン教会に関連する情報が含まれる、海外のサーバー上でデータ、攻撃記録、アカウント情報を発見した。

オアシス・セキュリティーは７日、攻撃の記録には「サブエージェント」への言及や、自動化されたように見える詳細な攻撃レポートなど、侵入の際にＡＩツールが使用されたことを示唆する兆候が含まれていたと発表した。

汝矣島純福音教会は７日、初期の分析結果から、８５万人の信徒に関するデータが流出した可能性があるとの見解を示した。

データには氏名や生年月日が含まれており、一部には日本のマイナンバーにあたる住民登録番号、住所などの情報も含まれていた。同教会は、影響を受けた信徒への通知、外部からのアクセス遮断、サーバーのパスワード変更を進めているという。

サラン教会は、緊急対策チームを結成し、疑わしい事案を関係当局に通報するとともに、事態の解明とさらなる被害の防止に向けた措置を講じていると説明した。

オアシス・セキュリティーによると、攻撃者は同教会の会員管理システムの脆弱性を悪用し、最大８万９５８０件の登録ユーザーアカウントに関連するデータへのアクセスが可能になった可能性があるという。

韓国では先週、商業銀行に対するハッキングで顧客の個人情報が流出する事案が起き、李在明大統領は攻撃にＡＩが使用されたとの見解を示した。

items.title: アングル：米中間選「ねじれ」でも株高の経験則、今年はＡＩ規制に要警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ７日 ロイター] - 日本株が年末高に向けて勢いを維持できるかどうかを見極める上で、１１月３日投開票の米中間選挙の結果が注目されている。予測市場では民主党の下院奪還が有力視されているが、過去の経験則（アノマリー）では「ねじれ議会下での株高」が日米ともに高い確率で起こっている。ただ、民主党が勢力を拡大し人工知能（ＡＩ）データセンター建設の規制強化の波が広がるようだと相場の腰折れにもつながりかねないだけに楽観はできない。

＜選挙後３カ月、日本株３％高＞

三井住友ＤＳアセットマネジメントが１９８２年以降の過去１１回の米中間選挙を検証したところ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種株価指数は、選挙前の３カ月間に平均３．８％、選挙後の３カ月間に平均５．９％上昇した。選挙後上昇の確率は８１．８％に上る。同社の市川雅浩チーフマーケットストラテジストは「政局の不透明感は選挙の約１カ月前から市場で消化され始め、選挙後にあく抜けし、一段高になる傾向がある」とみている。

日本株はどうか。市川氏は、株価動向のばらつきは米株より大きく「日本固有の要因の影響も受けるため、米国株ほどきれいな形にはならない」と指摘。それでも、８２年以降の１１回で日経平均株価は、選挙前の３カ月間に平均で約３％下落し、選挙後の３カ月間に約３．３％上昇した。選挙の約１カ月前から株価は上昇し始め、選挙後に一段高になる流れは米国株と同じという。

もっとも、足元の相場は、平均的な選挙年とは様相が異なる。８月３日から今月６日までの上昇率は約１０％と、過去１１回の同期間平均の約マイナス４％を大きく上振れている。成長期待のある半導体株が相場をけん引していることに加え、国内のインフレ環境も異なることが影響していそうだと市川氏はみている。

＜強まるねじれ観測＞

今回の米中間選挙では、トランプ大統領の共和党が議会で主導権を失うシナリオが意識されている。予測市場ポリマーケットでは６日時点で、民主党が下院を奪還する確率は９３％、上院を奪還する確率は６５％に達する。ＪＰモルガンの集計では、１９３４年以降の中間選挙で、現職大統領の与党は平均して下院で約２７議席、上院で約３議席を失ってきた。現在の議席数は、下院で共和２１９（うち無所属１）、民主２１４、欠員２、上院で共和５３、民主４７（うち無所属２）となっている。

大統領が共和党、上下両院が民主党となる完全なねじれの場合、法律の制定や予算関連法案の成立には野党の協力が必要となり、内政上の政策が停滞しやすくなる。下院のみ民主党が多数となる部分的ねじれでも、法案は両院での可決が必要なため、立法面での制約は大きい。一方、閣僚や連邦判事などの主要人事には上院の承認が必要なため、上院の多数を維持できれば、大統領は人事を通じて政策を進める余地を保てるとされる。

＜ねじれは株価にプラスの経験則も＞

過去には「ねじれ」が株価にプラスだった様子もうかがえる。ねじれは「主に政策面でのダウンサイドリスクを限定的にする要因として、市場にプラスに働く」とＪＰモルガンの西原里江チーフ株式ストラテジストは分析する。ＪＰモルガンによる１９５０年以降の集計では、新議会の発足から任期２年間でみるとＳ＆Ｐ５００のリターンは、上下両院で多数派が異なるねじれ議会下でプラス２５％となり、単一政党が両院を支配する場合のプラス１８％を上回る。

ねじれによって、急進的な法案が通りにくくなり、政策変更に伴う不確実性が抑えられるためとされる。ＪＰモルガンは、メディケイドの追加削減や連邦政府による薬価規制の拡大の可能性が低下するヘルスケアや、既に予算が確保されている防衛・インフラ関連が恩恵を受けやすいとの見方を示す。

民主党が両院を制するケースでは、メディケイド削減が延期・撤回されれば、医療保険の対象者が維持される病院運営関連や、支援拡大が見込まれるクリーンエネルギー関連が下支えされる一方、共和党が議会の支配を続ければ、ＡＩインフラ整備の拡大や従来型エネルギー、電力網インフラに追い風という。

＜一段高に業績裏付け必要か、ＡＩ投資に目配り＞

株価の発射台が高まる中で中間選挙を迎えることになるが、ＵＢＳ　ＳｕＭｉ　ＴＲＵＳＴウェルス・マネジメントの小林千紗日本株ストラテジストは日本株について「（選挙後は）不透明感が解消することで、年末に向けていったん株高になるのではないか」とみる一人だ。

金利の高止まりが警戒される中ではバリュエーションの伸び余地が限られそうな一方、「業績が崩れなければ、株価には上昇余地がある」と小林氏はみている。中間選挙は、国内の３月決算企業の中間決算シーズンとも重なる。

もっとも、ねじれになれば、民主党主導でデータセンターの規制を強める機運が高まりかねず、「投資が後ずれするリスクが意識されてくる可能性がある」という。一方、次期大統領選に向けて政策変更の不確実性を意識した企業が、短期的にはＡＩ設備投資を前倒しする可能性もあるとＪＰモルガンは予測する。

ＡＩ投資のスケジュールに変化が生じれば、株価にも影響が及ぶ可能性がある。日経平均で比重の高い半導体関連株の業績を直接左右しかねないだけに「選挙後もデータセンター投資を巡る動向への目配りを怠れない」とＪＰモルガンの西原氏は話している。

（平田紀之　編集：橋本浩）
